features.text: Always prepared. 1st: Charm Person, Disguise Self. 3rd: Mirror Image, Pass without Trace. 5th: Blink, Dispel Magic. 7th: Dimension Door, Polymorph. 9th: Dominate Person, Modify Memory.

features.name: Blessing of the Trickster
features.text: As an action, give a willing creature advantage on Stealth checks for 1 hour.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Invoke Duplicity
features.text: As an action, create an illusion of yourself for 1 minute (concentration); cast spells from its space and gain advantage against creatures next to it.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows
features.text: As an action, become invisible until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.text: Once per turn, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 poison damage (2d8 at 14th).

features.name: Improved Duplicity
features.text: Invoke Duplicity creates up to four duplicates.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.text: Always prepared. 1st: Faerie Fire, Sleep. 3rd: Moonbeam, See Invisibility. 5th: Aura of Vitality, Leomund's Tiny Hut. 7th: Aura of Life, Greater Invisibility. 9th: Circle of Power, Mislead.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.text: Proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

features.name: Eyes of Night
features.text: Darkvision 300 feet, which you can share with allies as an action once per long rest.

features.name: Vigilant Blessing
features.text: As an action, give a creature advantage on its next initiative roll.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Twilight Sanctuary
features.text: As an action, create a 30-foot sphere of twilight for 1 minute; creatures ending their turn in it gain 1d6 + cleric level temp HP or end charmed or frightened.

features.name: Steps of Night
features.text: As a bonus action in dim light or darkness, gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed for 1 minute. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.text: Once per turn, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 radiant damage (2d8 at 14th).

features.name: Twilight Shroud
features.text: Your Twilight Sanctuary also gives half cover to you and allies inside.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.text: Always prepared. 1st: Divine Favor, Shield of Faith. 3rd: Magic Weapon, Spiritual Weapon. 5th: Crusader's Mantle, Spirit Guardians. 7th: Freedom of Movement, Stoneskin. 9th: Flame Strike, Hold Monster.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.text: Proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

features.name: War Priest
features.text: When you take the Attack action, make one weapon attack as a bonus action. Wisdom modifier uses per long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
features.text: Add +10 to one of your attack rolls after seeing the roll.

features.name: Channel Divinity: War God's Blessing
features.text: As a reaction, add +10 to the attack roll of a creature within 30 feet.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.text: Once per turn, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 damage of the weapon's type (2d8 at 14th).

features.name: Avatar of Battle
features.text: Resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.

features.name: Balm of the Summer Court
features.text: A pool of d6s equal to your druid level: as a bonus action, heal a creature within 120 feet by spending up to half your level in dice, plus 1 temp HP per die. Refills on a long rest.

features.name: Hearth of Moonlight and Shadow
features.text: During a short or long rest, create a 30-foot sphere that gives +5 to Stealth and Perception checks and hides light from outside.

features.name: Hidden Paths
features.text: As a bonus action, teleport up to 60 feet, or as an action teleport a willing creature you touch 30 feet. Wisdom modifier uses per long rest.

features.name: Walker in Dreams
features.text: After a short rest, cast Dream, Scrying or Teleportation Circle without a slot or components (the circle leads to your last long rest spot). Once per long rest.

features.name: Bonus Cantrip
features.text: Learn one extra druid cantrip.

features.name: Natural Recovery
features.text: Once per long rest during a short rest, recover spell slots with combined levels up to half your druid level (rounded up), none 6th level or higher.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.text: Choose a land; its spells are always prepared at druid levels 3, 5, 7 and 9. Arctic: Hold Person, Spike Growth / Sleet Storm, Slow / Freedom of Movement, Ice Storm / Commune with Nature, Cone of Cold. Coast: Mirror Image, Misty Step / Water Breathing, Water Walk / Control Water, Freedom of Movement / Conjure Elemental, Scrying. Desert: Blur, Silence / Create Food and Water, Protection from Energy / Blight, Hallucinatory Terrain / Insect Plague, Wall of Stone. Forest: Barkskin, Spider Climb / Call Lightning, Plant Growth / Divination, Freedom of Movement / Commune with Nature, Tree Stride. Grassland: Invisibility, Pass without Trace / Daylight, Haste / Divination, Freedom of Movement / Dream, Insect Plague. Mountain: Spider Climb, Spike Growth / Lightning Bolt, Meld into Stone / Stone Shape, Stoneskin / Passwall, Wall of Stone. Swamp: Darkness, Melf's Acid Arrow / Water Walk, Stinking Cloud / Freedom of Movement, Locate Creature / Insect Plague, Scrying. Underdark: Spider Climb, Web / Gaseous Form, Stinking Cloud / Greater Invisibility, Stone Shape / Cloudkill, Insect Plague.

features.name: Land's Stride
features.text: Nonmagical difficult terrain costs no extra movement, plants don't harm you, and you have advantage against magical plants that impede movement.

features.name: Nature's Ward
features.text: You can't be charmed or frightened by elementals or fey, and you're immune to poison and disease.

features.name: Nature's Sanctuary
features.text: Beasts and plants that attack you must make a Wisdom save or choose another target; on a success they're immune for 24 hours.

features.name: Combat Wild Shape
features.text: Use Wild Shape as a bonus action, and while transformed spend a spell slot as a bonus action to regain 1d8 HP per slot level.

features.name: Circle Forms
features.text: Wild Shape into beasts of CR 1 at 2nd level and CR equal to druid level divided by 3 from 6th level.

features.name: Primal Strike
features.text: Your attacks in beast form count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity.

features.name: Elemental Wild Shape
features.text: Spend two Wild Shape uses to transform into an air, earth, fire or water elemental.

features.name: Thousand Forms
features.text: You can cast Alter Self at will.

features.name: Speech of the Woods
features.text: You learn Sylvan and can speak with beasts, which can understand you.

features.name: Spirit Totem
features.text: As a bonus action, summon a 30-foot spirit aura for 1 minute: Bear (temp HP and Strength advantage), Hawk (reaction to grant advantage on an attack) or Unicorn (Perception advantage and extra healing). Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Mighty Summoner
features.text: Beasts and fey you summon with spells gain 2 extra HP per Hit Die and their natural weapons count as magical.

features.name: Guardian Spirit
features.text: Beasts and fey you summon that end their turn in your Spirit Totem aura regain HP equal to half your druid level.

features.name: Faithful Summons
features.text: When you drop to 0 HP or are incapacitated against your will, gain the benefits of Conjure Animals as if cast with a 9th-level slot. Once per long rest.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.text: Always prepared. 2nd: Chill Touch. 3rd: Blindness/Deafness, Gentle Repose. 5th: Animate Dead, Gaseous Form. 7th: Blight, Confusion. 9th: Cloudkill, Contagion.

features.name: Halo of Spores
features.text: As a reaction, deal necrotic damage (1d4, growing with level) to a creature that moves into or starts its turn within 10 feet, unless it succeeds on a Constitution save.

features.name: Symbiotic Entity
features.text: Spend a Wild Shape use to gain 4 temp HP per druid level for 10 minutes; while you have them, Halo of Spores doubles its dice and melee hits deal an extra 1d6 necrotic.

features.name: Fungal Infestation
features.text: As a reaction, animate a Small or Medium beast or humanoid that dies within 10 feet as a 1-HP zombie for 1 hour. Wisdom modifier uses per long rest.

features.name: Spreading Spores
features.text: While Symbiotic Entity is active, use a bonus action to place a 10-foot cube of spores that deals your Halo damage to creatures in it.

features.name: Fungal Body
features.text: Immune to blinded, deafened, frightened and poisoned, and critical hits against you become normal hits unless you're incapacitated.

features.name: Star Map
features.text: Your star chart is a focus; you know Guidance, always have Guiding Bolt prepared, and can cast it without a slot proficiency bonus times per long rest.

features.name: Starry Form
features.text: Spend a Wild Shape use to take a starry form for 10 minutes: Archer (bonus action radiant attack), Chalice (extra healing) or Dragon (minimum 10 on concentration and Int or Wis checks).

features.name: Cosmic Omen
features.text: After a long rest, roll a die: even lets you add 1d6 to a creature's roll as a reaction, odd subtract 1d6. Proficiency bonus uses.

features.name: Twinkling Constellations
features.text: Archer and Chalice use 2d8, Dragon grants a 20-foot flying speed with hover, and you can switch constellations each turn.

features.name: Full of Stars
features.text: In starry form, you resist bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.text: Always prepared. 2nd: Burning Hands, Cure Wounds. 3rd: Flaming Sphere, Scorching Ray. 5th: Plant Growth, Revivify. 7th: Aura of Life, Fire Shield. 9th: Flame Strike, Mass Cure Wounds.

features.name: Summon Wildfire Spirit
features.text: Spend a Wild Shape use to summon a wildfire spirit for 1 hour; creatures near where it appears take fire damage on a failed Dexterity save.

features.name: Enhanced Bond
features.text: While your spirit is summoned, add 1d8 to one roll of your fire damage or healing spells, and your spells can originate from the spirit.

features.name: Cauterizing Flames
features.text: When a creature dies near you or your spirit, a flame appears; as a reaction, a creature entering it is healed or burned 2d10 + Wisdom modifier. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Blazing Revival
features.text: If you drop to 0 HP while your spirit is within 120 feet, it drops to 0 instead and you regain half your HP and stand up. Once per long rest.

features.name: Arcane Archer Lore
features.text: Proficiency in Arcana or Nature, and learn Prestidigitation or Druidcraft.

features.name: Arcane Shot
features.text: Learn two Arcane Shot options; once per turn, apply one when you hit with a bow. Two uses per short or long rest; more options at 7th, 10th, 15th and 18th level, and damage grows at 18th.

features.name: Magic Arrow
features.text: Arrows you fire from a bow count as magical.

features.name: Curving Shot
features.text: When you miss with a magic arrow, use a bonus action to reroll the attack against another target within 60 feet.

features.name: Ever-Ready Shot
features.text: When you roll initiative with no Arcane Shot uses left, you regain one.

features.name: Rallying Cry
features.text: When you use Second Wind, up to three allies within 60 feet regain HP equal to your fighter level.

features.name: Royal Envoy
features.text: Proficiency in Persuasion (or another social skill), with double proficiency on Persuasion checks.

features.name: Inspiring Surge
features.text: When you use Action Surge, an ally within 60 feet can use its reaction to make a melee or ranged attack (two allies at 18th level).

features.name: Bulwark
features.text: When you use Indomitable on an Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma save, an ally within 60 feet who failed the same save can reroll it.

features.name: Combat Superiority
features.text: Learn three maneuvers and gain four d8 superiority dice that return on a short or long rest. More maneuvers at 7th, 10th and 15th; more dice at 7th and 15th.

features.name: Student of War
features.text: Proficiency with one type of artisan's tools.

features.name: Know Your Enemy
features.text: After studying a creature for 1 minute, learn whether it's your equal, superior or inferior in two characteristics.

features.name: Improved Combat Superiority
features.text: Superiority dice become d10s (d12s at 18th level).

features.name: Relentless
features.text: When you roll initiative with no superiority dice, you regain one.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.text: Proficiency in Animal Handling, History, Insight, Performance or Persuasion, or a language.

features.name: Born to the Saddle
features.text: Advantage on saves to avoid falling off a mount, land on your feet if you fall, and mounting costs only 5 feet.

features.name: Unwavering Mark
features.text: When you hit a creature, mark it: it has disadvantage attacking others, and if it does, you can make a bonus action attack with extra damage. Strength modifier uses per long rest.

features.name: Warding Maneuver
features.text: As a reaction, add 1d8 to the AC of you or an adjacent ally against an attack and give resistance if it hits. Constitution modifier uses per long rest.

features.name: Hold the Line
features.text: Creatures provoke opportunity attacks when they move 5 feet or more within your reach, and a hit stops their movement.

features.name: Ferocious Charger
features.text: If you move 10 feet in a straight line before hitting, the target makes a Strength save or is knocked prone. Once per turn.

features.name: Vigilant Defender
features.text: You get a special reaction you can use once on every other creature's turn, only for opportunity attacks.

features.name: Improved Critical
features.text: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a 19 or 20.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.text: Add half your proficiency bonus to Strength, Dexterity and Constitution checks that don't use it, and running jumps go farther.

features.name: Additional Fighting Style
features.text: Choose a second Fighting Style.

features.name: Superior Critical
features.text: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on an 18 to 20.

features.name: Survivor
features.text: At the start of your turn, if you have no more than half your HP, regain 5 + Constitution modifier HP.

features.name: Manifest Echo
features.text: As a bonus action, create an echo of yourself within 15 feet; you can swap places with it, move it, and attack from its space.

features.name: Unleash Incarnation
features.text: When you take the Attack action, make an extra melee attack from your echo's position. Constitution modifier uses per long rest.

features.name: Echo Avatar
features.text: As an action, see and hear through your echo for 10 minutes and move it up to 1,000 feet away.

features.name: Shadow Martyr
features.text: As a reaction, teleport your echo next to an ally so an attack targets the echo instead. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Reclaim Potential
features.text: When your echo is destroyed, gain temp HP 2d6 + Constitution modifier. Constitution modifier uses per long rest.

features.name: Legion of One
features.text: You can have two echoes at once, and you regain one Unleash Incarnation use when you roll initiative without any.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.text: Learn wizard cantrips and spells (mostly abjuration and evocation) cast with Intelligence. The app sets this class as a Third caster with INT when you choose this subclass.

features.name: Weapon Bond
features.text: Bond with up to two weapons; you can't be disarmed of them and can summon one to your hand as a bonus action.

features.name: War Magic
features.text: When you cast a cantrip with your action, make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

features.name: Eldritch Strike
features.text: When you hit with a weapon, the target has disadvantage on its next save against your spells before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Arcane Charge
features.text: When you use Action Surge, teleport up to 30 feet.

features.name: Improved War Magic
features.text: When you cast a spell with your action, make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.text: Psionic Energy dice (twice your proficiency bonus) fuel Protective Field (reduce damage), Psionic Strike (extra force damage) and Telekinetic Movement. Dice return on a long rest, one on a short rest.

features.name: Telekinetic Adept
features.text: Psi-Powered Leap gives a flying speed of twice your walking speed for the turn, and Telekinetic Thrust can knock targets prone or push them.

features.name: Guarded Mind
features.text: Resistance to psychic damage, and you can spend a die to end charmed or frightened on yourself.

features.name: Bulwark of Force
features.text: As a bonus action, give up to Intelligence modifier creatures half cover for 1 minute. Once per long rest or a die.

features.name: Telekinetic Master
features.text: Cast Telekinesis without a slot once per long rest (or by spending a die), and make a weapon attack as a bonus action while concentrating on it.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.text: Proficiency with smith's tools and the Giant language.

features.name: Rune Carver
features.text: Learn two runes and inscribe them on gear; each gives a passive benefit and an activated effect once per short or long rest. More runes at 7th, 10th and 15th level.

features.name: Giant's Might
features.text: As a bonus action, become Large for 1 minute: advantage on Strength checks and saves and an extra 1d6 damage once per turn. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Runic Shield
features.text: As a reaction, force a creature to reroll an attack against an ally within 60 feet. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Great Stature
features.text: You grow 3d4 inches, and Giant's Might deals an extra 1d8 instead.

features.name: Master of Runes
features.text: You can use each rune's activated effect twice per short or long rest.

features.name: Runic Juggernaut
features.text: Giant's Might can make you Huge, adds 1d10 damage, and increases your reach by 5 feet.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.text: Proficiency in History, Insight, Performance or Persuasion, or a language.

features.name: Fighting Spirit
features.text: As a bonus action, gain advantage on weapon attacks this turn and temp HP (5, growing with level). Three uses per long rest.

features.name: Elegant Courtier
features.text: Add your Wisdom modifier to Persuasion checks, and gain proficiency in Wisdom saves (or Intelligence or Charisma).

features.name: Tireless Spirit
features.text: When you roll initiative with no Fighting Spirit uses left, you regain one.

features.name: Rapid Strike
features.text: Once per turn, if you have advantage on an attack, give it up to make an additional attack.

features.name: Strength before Death
features.text: When reduced to 0 HP, use your reaction to take an extra turn immediately. Once per long rest.

features.name: Implements of Mercy
features.text: Proficiency in Insight, Medicine and the herbalism kit, plus a special mask.

features.name: Hand of Healing
features.text: Spend 1 ki to heal a creature a Martial Arts die + Wisdom modifier; you can replace a Flurry of Blows strike with it for free.

features.name: Hand of Harm
features.text: Once per turn when you hit with an unarmed strike, spend 1 ki to add a Martial Arts die + Wisdom modifier necrotic damage.

features.name: Physician's Touch
features.text: Hand of Healing can end a disease or blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned or stunned; Hand of Harm can poison the target.

features.name: Flurry of Healing and Harm
features.text: Replace each Flurry of Blows strike with Hand of Healing without ki, and add Hand of Harm to one strike for free.

features.name: Hand of Ultimate Mercy
features.text: Spend 5 ki to revive a creature that died within 24 hours with 4d10 + Wisdom modifier HP. Once per long rest.

features.name: Draconic Disciple
features.text: Unarmed strikes can deal acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison damage, you can reroll failed Intimidation or Persuasion checks, and you learn Draconic.

features.name: Breath of the Dragon
features.text: Replace an attack with a 20-foot cone or 30-foot line of elemental breath. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest, or 2 ki.

features.name: Wings Unfurled
features.text: When you use Step of the Wind, gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed until the end of the turn. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Aspect of the Wyrm
features.text: As a bonus action, create a 10-foot aura for 1 minute that frightens creatures or gives allies resistance to an element. Once per long rest or 3 ki.

features.name: Ascendant Aspect
features.text: Gain blindsight 10 feet, Breath of the Dragon deals more damage, and a reaction lets you deal damage when hit while Aspect of the Wyrm is active.

features.name: Arms of the Astral Self
features.text: As a bonus action, spend 1 ki to summon astral arms for 10 minutes: use Wisdom for unarmed strikes and Strength checks, 10-foot reach, and force damage. On summoning, nearby creatures take force damage.

features.name: Visage of the Astral Self
features.text: Spend 1 ki to summon an astral visage for 10 minutes: see in magical darkness, advantage on Insight and Intimidation, and focused speech.

features.name: Body of the Astral Self
features.text: With arms and visage summoned, reduce acid, cold, fire, force, lightning or thunder damage by a reaction, and add a Martial Arts die once per turn to arm hits.

features.name: Awakened Astral Self
features.text: Spend 5 ki to summon all three: +2 AC, and three arm attacks when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.text: Proficiency in Performance and with brewer's supplies.

features.name: Drunken Technique
features.text: When you use Flurry of Blows, you gain Disengage and your walking speed increases by 10 feet until the end of the turn.

features.name: Tipsy Sway
features.text: Stand up from prone with 5 feet of movement, and when a creature misses you, spend 1 ki to redirect the attack to another creature.

features.name: Drunkard's Luck
features.text: Spend 2 ki to cancel disadvantage on an ability check, attack roll or saving throw.

features.name: Intoxicated Frenzy
features.text: When you use Flurry of Blows, make up to three more attacks if each targets a different creature.

features.name: Disciple of the Elements
features.text: Learn Elemental Attunement and elemental disciplines that cost ki (some cast spells like Burning Hands or Fireball). More disciplines at 6th, 11th and 17th level.

features.name: Additional Discipline
features.text: Learn another elemental discipline; you can also swap one you know.

features.name: Additional Discipline
features.text: Learn another elemental discipline; you can also swap one you know.

features.name: Additional Discipline
features.text: Learn another elemental discipline; you can also swap one you know.

features.name: Path of the Kensei
features.text: Choose kensei weapons; gain AC while dual-wielding with an unarmed strike (Agile Parry), longer range as a bonus action (Kensei's Shot), and proficiency with calligrapher's or painter's supplies.

features.name: One with the Blade
features.text: Kensei weapons count as magical, and when you hit you can spend 1 ki to add a Martial Arts die to damage (Deft Strike).

features.name: Sharpen the Blade
features.text: As a bonus action, spend up to 3 ki to grant a kensei weapon that bonus to attack and damage for 1 minute.

features.name: Unerring Accuracy
features.text: Once per turn, reroll a missed attack with a monk weapon.

features.name: Touch of Death
features.text: When you reduce a creature within 5 feet to 0 HP, gain temp HP equal to Wisdom modifier + monk level.

features.name: Hour of Reaping
features.text: As an action, creatures within 30 feet that can see you make a Wisdom save or are frightened until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Mastery of Death
features.text: When reduced to 0 HP, spend 1 ki to drop to 1 HP instead.

features.name: Touch of the Long Death
features.text: As an action, touch a creature and spend 1 to 10 ki: it takes 2d10 necrotic per point (Constitution save for half).

features.name: Open Hand Technique
features.text: When you hit with Flurry of Blows, you can knock the target prone, push it 15 feet, or stop it from taking reactions.

features.name: Wholeness of Body
features.text: As an action, regain HP equal to three times your monk level. Once per long rest.

features.name: Tranquility
features.text: After a long rest, gain a Sanctuary effect until your next long rest or until you attack.

features.name: Quivering Palm
features.text: Spend 3 ki on an unarmed hit to set lethal vibrations; later, as an action, the target makes a Constitution save or drops to 0 HP (10d10 necrotic on a success).

features.name: Shadow Arts
features.text: Spend 2 ki to cast Darkness, Darkvision, Pass without Trace or Silence; you also learn Minor Illusion.

features.name: Shadow Step
features.text: As a bonus action in dim light or darkness, teleport up to 60 feet to another dim or dark space and gain advantage on your next melee attack.

features.name: Cloak of Shadows
features.text: As an action in dim light or darkness, become invisible until you attack, cast a spell or enter bright light.

features.name: Opportunist
features.text: When a creature within 5 feet is hit by someone else, use your reaction to make a melee attack against it.

features.name: Radiant Sun Bolt
features.text: Make ranged radiant spell-like attacks (30 feet) using Dexterity and your Martial Arts die; spend 1 ki for two bolts as a bonus action.

features.name: Searing Arc Strike
features.text: After the Attack action, spend 2 ki to cast Burning Hands as a bonus action, plus 1 ki per extra level.

features.name: Searing Sunburst
features.text: As an action, create a 20-foot radiant explosion (2d6, more with ki) on a failed Constitution save.

features.name: Sun Shield
features.text: Shed bright light, and when a creature hits you in melee, use your reaction to deal 5 + Wisdom modifier radiant damage to it.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.text: Always prepared. 3rd: Ensnaring Strike, Speak with Animals. 5th: Misty Step, Moonbeam. 9th: Plant Growth, Protection from Energy. 13th: Ice Storm, Stoneskin. 17th: Commune with Nature, Tree Stride.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.text: Nature's Wrath (restrain a creature with vines on a failed save) or Turn the Faithless (turn fey and fiends).

features.name: Aura of Warding
features.text: You and allies within 10 feet resist damage from spells (30 feet at 18th).

features.name: Undying Sentinel
features.text: When reduced to 0 HP, drop to 1 instead once per long rest; you also stop aging.

features.name: Elder Champion
features.text: Transform for 1 minute: regain 10 HP each turn, cast action spells as a bonus action, and enemies within 10 feet have disadvantage on saves against your spells. Once per long rest.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.text: Always prepared. 3rd: Armor of Agathys, Command. 5th: Hold Person, Spiritual Weapon. 9th: Bestow Curse, Fear. 13th: Dominate Beast, Stoneskin. 17th: Cloudkill, Dominate Person.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.text: Conquering Presence (frighten creatures within 30 feet) or Guided Strike (+10 to an attack roll).

features.name: Aura of Conquest
features.text: Frightened enemies within 10 feet have speed 0 and take psychic damage equal to half your paladin level on their turns (30 feet at 18th).

features.name: Scornful Rebuke
features.text: When a creature hits you, it takes psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier.

features.name: Invincible Conqueror
features.text: For 1 minute: resistance to all damage, an extra attack when you take the Attack action, and crits on 19 or 20. Once per long rest.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.text: Always prepared. 3rd: Command, Compelled Duel. 5th: Warding Bond, Zone of Truth. 9th: Aura of Vitality, Spirit Guardians. 13th: Banishment, Guardian of Faith. 17th: Circle of Power, Geas.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.text: Champion Challenge (creatures within 30 feet can't move away from you) or Turn the Tide (heal creatures within 30 feet that are at half HP or less).

features.name: Divine Allegiance
features.text: When a creature within 5 feet takes damage, use your reaction to take it instead.

features.name: Unyielding Spirit
features.text: Advantage on saves against paralyzed and stunned.

features.name: Exalted Champion
features.text: For 1 hour: resistance to nonmagical weapon damage, and you and allies within 30 feet have advantage on death saves and Wisdom saves. Once per long rest.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.text: Always prepared. 3rd: Protection from Evil and Good, Sanctuary. 5th: Lesser Restoration, Zone of Truth. 9th: Beacon of Hope, Dispel Magic. 13th: Freedom of Movement, Guardian of Faith. 17th: Commune, Flame Strike.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.text: Sacred Weapon (add Charisma modifier to attacks with a weapon for 1 minute) or Turn the Unholy (turn fiends and undead).

features.name: Aura of Devotion
features.text: You and allies within 10 feet can't be charmed (30 feet at 18th).

features.name: Purity of Spirit
features.text: You are always under the effects of Protection from Evil and Good.

features.name: Holy Nimbus
features.text: For 1 minute, emit sunlight that deals 10 radiant damage to enemies starting their turn within 30 feet, with advantage on saves against fiends' and undead spells. Once per long rest.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.text: Always prepared. 3rd: Guiding Bolt, Heroism. 5th: Enhance Ability, Magic Weapon. 9th: Haste, Protection from Energy. 13th: Compulsion, Freedom of Movement. 17th: Commune, Flame Strike.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.text: Peerless Athlete (advantage on Athletics and Acrobatics and better carrying and jumping for 10 minutes) or Inspiring Smite (share temp HP after a Divine Smite).

features.name: Aura of Alacrity
features.text: Your walking speed increases by 10 feet, and allies who start their turn within 5 feet gain the same bonus (10 feet at 18th).

features.name: Glorious Defense
features.text: As a reaction, add your Charisma modifier to AC for you or an ally; if the attack misses, make a weapon attack against the attacker. Charisma modifier uses per long rest.

features.name: Living Legend
features.text: For 1 minute: advantage on Charisma checks, turn a miss into a hit once per turn, and reroll failed saves. Once per long rest or a 5th-level slot.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.text: Always prepared. 3rd: Sanctuary, Sleep. 5th: Calm Emotions, Hold Person. 9th: Counterspell, Hypnotic Pattern. 13th: Otiluke's Resilient Sphere, Stoneskin. 17th: Hold Monster, Wall of Force.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.text: Emissary of Peace (+5 to Persuasion for 10 minutes) or Rebuke the Violent (an attacker takes radiant damage equal to what it dealt).

features.name: Aura of the Guardian
features.text: As a reaction, take the damage dealt to an ally within 10 feet instead (30 feet at 18th).

features.name: Protective Spirit
features.text: At the end of your turn, if you're below half HP, regain 1d6 + half your paladin level.

features.name: Emissary of Redemption
features.text: Resistance to all damage from creatures, and they take radiant damage equal to half what they deal to you, until you attack or harm them.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.text: Always prepared. 3rd: Bane, Hunter's Mark. 5th: Hold Person, Misty Step. 9th: Haste, Protection from Energy. 13th: Banishment, Dimension Door. 17th: Hold Monster, Scrying.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.text: Abjure Enemy (frighten a creature and reduce its speed to 0) or Vow of Enmity (advantage on attacks against a creature for 1 minute).

features.name: Relentless Avenger
features.text: When you hit with an opportunity attack, move up to half your speed as part of the reaction without provoking.

features.name: Soul of Vengeance
features.text: When the target of your Vow of Enmity attacks, use your reaction to make a melee attack against it.

features.name: Avenging Angel
features.text: For 1 hour, gain a 60-foot flying speed and a 30-foot frightening aura. Once per long rest.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.text: Always prepared. 3rd: Alarm, Detect Magic. 5th: Moonbeam, See Invisibility. 9th: Counterspell, Nondetection. 13th: Aura of Purity, Banishment. 17th: Hold Monster, Scrying.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.text: Watcher's Will (advantage on mental saves for you and allies for 1 minute) or Abjure the Extraplanar (turn aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey and fiends).

features.name: Aura of the Sentinel
features.text: You and allies within 10 feet add your proficiency bonus to initiative (30 feet at 18th).

features.name: Vigilant Rebuke
features.text: When you or an ally within 30 feet succeeds on an Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma save, deal 2d8 + Charisma modifier force damage to the source.

features.name: Mortal Bulwark
features.text: For 1 minute: truesight 120 feet, advantage against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey and fiends, and banish them on a hit. Once per long rest.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.text: Always prepared. 3rd: Hellish Rebuke, Inflict Wounds. 5th: Crown of Madness, Darkness. 9th: Animate Dead, Bestow Curse. 13th: Blight, Confusion. 17th: Contagion, Dominate Person.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.text: Control Undead (control an undead for 24 hours) or Dreadful Aspect (frighten creatures within 30 feet).

features.name: Aura of Hate
features.text: You and fiends and undead within 10 feet add your Charisma modifier to melee weapon damage (30 feet at 18th).

features.name: Supernatural Resistance
features.text: Resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.

features.name: Dread Lord
features.text: For 1 minute, a 30-foot aura of gloom reduces bright light, frightened enemies take psychic damage, and you can make shadowy necrotic attacks as a bonus action. Once per long rest.

features.name: Ranger's Companion
features.text: Gain a beast companion of CR 1/4 or lower that obeys your commands; with Tasha's you can instead use a Primal Beast (land, sea or sky).

features.name: Exceptional Training
features.text: Command your beast to Dash, Disengage or Help as a bonus action, and its attacks count as magical.

features.name: Bestial Fury
features.text: Your beast can make two attacks when commanded to Attack.

features.name: Share Spells
features.text: Spells you cast on yourself can also affect your beast within 30 feet.

features.name: Draconic Gift
features.text: Learn Thaumaturgy and Draconic.

features.name: Drake Companion
features.text: As an action, summon a drake companion that acts on your turn and gives Infused Strikes; once per long rest or a slot.

features.name: Bond of Fang and Scale
features.text: The drake grows Medium, can be ridden, gains a flying speed, resistance to its element, and extra bite damage.

features.name: Drake's Breath
features.text: As an action, you or the drake exhale a 30-foot cone of elemental damage. Once per long rest or a 3rd-level slot.

features.name: Perfected Bond
features.text: The drake becomes Large, adds 1d6 to bites, and can use its reaction to give you resistance to an attack's damage.

features.name: Dreadful Strikes
features.text: Once per turn per creature, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d4 psychic damage (1d6 at 11th).

features.name: Fey Wanderer Magic
features.text: Always prepared. 3rd: Charm Person. 5th: Misty Step. 9th: Dispel Magic. 13th: Dimension Door. 17th: Mislead. You also gain a fey trait.

features.name: Otherworldly Glamour
features.text: Add your Wisdom modifier to Charisma checks and gain proficiency in Deception, Performance or Persuasion.

features.name: Beguiling Twist
features.text: Advantage on saves against charmed and frightened, and when a creature succeeds against them, use a reaction to charm or frighten another creature.

features.name: Fey Reinforcements
features.text: Summon Fey is always prepared and castable once per long rest without a slot or material; you can make it non-concentration for 1 minute.

features.name: Misty Wanderer
features.text: Cast Misty Step without a slot Wisdom modifier times per long rest, bringing a willing creature along.

features.name: Gloom Stalker Magic
features.text: Always prepared. 3rd: Disguise Self. 5th: Rope Trick. 9th: Fear. 13th: Greater Invisibility. 17th: Seeming.

features.name: Dread Ambusher
features.text: Add your Wisdom modifier to initiative; on your first turn of combat your walking speed increases by 10 feet and an Attack can make one extra attack dealing 1d8 more.

features.name: Umbral Sight
features.text: Darkvision 60 feet (or +30), and you're invisible to creatures relying on darkvision to see you in darkness.

features.name: Iron Mind
features.text: Proficiency in Wisdom saves (or Intelligence or Charisma if you have it).

features.name: Stalker's Flurry
features.text: Once per turn, when you miss with a weapon attack, make another attack.

features.name: Shadowy Dodge
features.text: When attacked without advantage, use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack.

features.name: Horizon Walker Magic
features.text: Always prepared. 3rd: Protection from Evil and Good. 5th: Misty Step. 9th: Haste. 13th: Banishment. 17th: Teleportation Circle.

features.name: Detect Portal
features.text: As an action, sense the distance and direction of the nearest planar portal within 1 mile. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Planar Warrior
features.text: As a bonus action, choose a creature within 30 feet; your next hit on it this turn deals force damage plus 1d8 (2d8 at 11th).

features.name: Ethereal Step
features.text: As a bonus action, cast Etherealness until the end of the turn. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Distant Strike
features.text: When you take the Attack action, teleport 10 feet before each attack, and attack a third creature if you hit two different ones.

features.name: Spectral Defense
features.text: When you take damage from an attack, use your reaction to gain resistance to it.

features.name: Hunter's Prey
features.text: Choose Colossus Slayer (extra 1d8 once per turn on a wounded target), Giant Killer (reaction attack against Large creatures) or Horde Breaker (an extra attack on an adjacent target).

features.name: Defensive Tactics
features.text: Choose Escape the Horde, Multiattack Defense (+4 AC after a hit) or Steel Will (advantage against frightened).

features.name: Multiattack
features.text: Choose Volley (ranged attack against every creature in a 10-foot radius) or Whirlwind Attack (melee attack against every creature within 5 feet).

features.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
features.text: Choose Evasion, Stand Against the Tide (redirect a missed attack) or Uncanny Dodge.

features.name: Monster Slayer Magic
features.text: Always prepared. 3rd: Protection from Evil and Good. 5th: Zone of Truth. 9th: Magic Circle. 13th: Banishment. 17th: Hold Monster.

features.name: Hunter's Sense
features.text: As an action, learn a creature's immunities, resistances and vulnerabilities. Wisdom modifier uses per long rest.

features.name: Slayer's Prey
features.text: As a bonus action, designate a creature within 60 feet; the first hit on it each turn deals an extra 1d6.

features.name: Supernatural Defense
features.text: Add 1d6 to saves and grapple escapes forced by your Slayer's Prey target.

features.name: Magic-User's Nemesis
features.text: As a reaction, foil a spell or teleport by a creature within 60 feet on a failed Wisdom save. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Slayer's Counter
features.text: When your Slayer's Prey target forces you to save, use your reaction to attack it; a hit makes your save succeed.

features.name: Gathered Swarm
features.text: Your swarm of spirits adds once per turn on a hit: an extra 1d6 piercing, a 15-foot push, or moving you 5 feet.

features.name: Swarmkeeper Magic
features.text: You learn Mage Hand; always prepared: 3rd Faerie Fire, 5th Web, 9th Gaseous Form, 13th Arcane Eye, 17th Insect Plague.

features.name: Writhing Tide
features.text: As a bonus action, gain a 10-foot flying speed with hover for 1 minute. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Mighty Swarm
features.text: Gathered Swarm deals 1d8, the push knocks prone, and moving with it gives half cover.

features.name: Swarming Dispersal
features.text: When you take damage, use your reaction to gain resistance and teleport 30 feet. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.text: Learn wizard cantrips and spells (mostly enchantment and illusion) cast with Intelligence. The app sets this class as a Third caster with INT when you choose this subclass.

features.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
features.text: Your Mage Hand is invisible and can stow or retrieve objects, pick locks and disarm traps; control it with Cunning Action.

features.name: Magical Ambush
features.text: If you are hidden when you cast a spell, the target has disadvantage on its save.

features.name: Versatile Trickster
features.text: As a bonus action, use your Mage Hand to distract a creature within 5 feet of it, gaining advantage on attacks against it.

features.name: Spell Thief
features.text: When a creature casts a spell targeting you, use your reaction to force a save; on a failure you negate it and can steal it for 8 hours. Once per long rest.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.text: Proficiency with the disguise kit and the poisoner's kit.

features.name: Assassinate
features.text: Advantage against creatures that haven't acted yet, and any hit against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

features.name: Infiltration Expertise
features.text: Spend time and money to create a false identity.

features.name: Impostor
features.text: Unerringly mimic another person's speech, writing and behavior after studying them.

features.name: Death Strike
features.text: When you hit a surprised creature, it makes a Constitution save or takes double damage.

features.name: Ear for Deceit
features.text: When you make an Insight check to detect lies, treat a d8 roll or lower as an 8.

features.name: Eye for Detail
features.text: Use a bonus action to make a Perception check to spot hidden things or an Investigation check to find clues.

features.name: Insightful Fighting
features.text: As a bonus action, an Insight check against a creature's Deception lets you Sneak Attack it without advantage for 1 minute.

features.name: Steady Eye
features.text: Advantage on Perception and Investigation checks if you move no more than half your speed.

features.name: Unerring Eye
features.text: As an action, sense illusions, shapechangers and deceptive magic within 30 feet. Wisdom modifier uses per long rest.

features.name: Eye for Weakness
features.text: Your Sneak Attack against a creature you've read with Insightful Fighting deals an extra 3d6.

features.name: Master of Intrigue
features.text: Proficiency with the disguise kit, forgery kit and a gaming set, two languages, and you can mimic speech patterns.

features.name: Master of Tactics
features.text: You can use the Help action as a bonus action, and help an ally attacking a creature within 30 feet.

features.name: Insightful Manipulator
features.text: After observing a creature for 1 minute, learn how it compares to you in two characteristics.

features.name: Misdirection
features.text: When targeted by an attack while a creature gives you cover, use your reaction to make the attack target that creature.

features.name: Soul of Deceit
features.text: Your thoughts can't be read, you can present false thoughts, and magic can't force you to tell the truth.

features.name: Whispers of the Dead
features.text: After a rest, gain proficiency with one skill or tool of your choice.

features.name: Wails from the Grave
features.text: After you deal Sneak Attack, deal necrotic damage equal to half your Sneak Attack dice to a second creature within 30 feet. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Tokens of the Departed
features.text: When a creature dies near you, create a soul trinket; it gives advantage on death and Constitution saves and fuels Wails from the Grave or questions to the spirit.

features.name: Ghost Walk
features.text: As a bonus action, become spectral for 10 minutes: fly 10 feet, move through objects, and attacks against you have disadvantage. Once per long rest or a trinket.

features.name: Death's Friend
features.text: Wails from the Grave hits both creatures, and you get a soul trinket after a long rest if you have none.

features.name: Skirmisher
features.text: When an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet, use your reaction to move half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Survivalist
features.text: Proficiency and expertise in Nature and Survival.

features.name: Superior Mobility
features.text: Your walking speed increases by 10 feet, along with your climbing and swimming speeds.

features.name: Ambush Master
features.text: Advantage on initiative, and the first creature you hit in the first round gives allies advantage against it.

features.name: Sudden Strike
features.text: When you take the Attack action, make a bonus action attack that can also deal Sneak Attack, against a different target.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.text: Psionic Energy dice (twice your proficiency bonus) fuel Psi-Bolstered Knack and Psychic Whispers. One returns on a short rest, all on a long rest.

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.text: When you attack, manifest a psychic blade (1d6 psychic, finesse, thrown), and throw a second one as a bonus action (1d4).

features.name: Soul Blades
features.text: Homing Strikes (add a die to a missed blade attack) and Psychic Teleportation (spend a die to teleport by throwing a blade).

features.name: Psychic Veil
features.text: As an action, become invisible for 1 hour or until you damage or force a save. Once per long rest or a die.

features.name: Rend Mind
features.text: When your blades deal Sneak Attack, the target makes a Wisdom save or is stunned for 1 minute. Once per long rest or three dice.

features.name: Fancy Footwork
features.text: When you make a melee attack against a creature, it can't make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of the turn.

features.name: Rakish Audacity
features.text: Add your Charisma modifier to initiative, and you can Sneak Attack a creature when no other creature is within 5 feet of you.

features.name: Panache
features.text: Use Persuasion against Insight to charm a non-hostile creature or make a hostile one focus on you.

features.name: Elegant Maneuver
features.text: As a bonus action, gain advantage on your next Acrobatics or Athletics check this turn.

features.name: Master Duelist
features.text: When you miss an attack, reroll it with advantage. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.text: Use Cunning Action for Sleight of Hand checks, thieves' tools, or the Use an Object action.

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.text: Climbing costs no extra movement, and running jumps go farther by your Dexterity modifier.

features.name: Supreme Sneak
features.text: Advantage on Stealth checks if you move no more than half your speed.

features.name: Use Magic Device
features.text: Ignore class, race and level requirements for using magic items.

features.name: Thief's Reflexes
features.text: Take two turns in the first round of combat, the second at your initiative minus 10.

features.name: Psionic Spells
features.text: Learn spells at set levels that you can swap for divination or enchantment spells. 1st: Arms of Hadar, Dissonant Whispers. 3rd: Calm Emotions, Detect Thoughts. 5th: Hunger of Hadar, Sending. 7th: Evard's Black Tentacles, Summon Aberration. 9th: Rary's Telepathic Bond, Telekinesis.

features.name: Telepathic Speech
features.text: As a bonus action, link telepathically with a creature within 30 feet for minutes equal to your sorcerer level.

features.name: Psionic Sorcery
features.text: Cast your Psionic Spells with sorcery points equal to their level and without verbal, somatic or most material components.

features.name: Psychic Defenses
features.text: Resistance to psychic damage and advantage on saves against charmed and frightened.

features.name: Revelation in Flesh
features.text: As a bonus action, spend sorcery points for 10 minutes of changes: see invisible, fly, swim and breathe water, or squeeze through tight spaces.

features.name: Warping Implosion
features.text: As an action, teleport up to 120 feet and pull creatures near your old spot, dealing force damage. Once per long rest or 5 sorcery points.

features.name: Clockwork Magic
features.text: Learn spells at set levels that you can swap for abjuration or transmutation spells. 1st: Alarm, Protection from Evil and Good. 3rd: Aid, Lesser Restoration. 5th: Dispel Magic, Protection from Energy. 7th: Freedom of Movement, Summon Construct. 9th: Greater Restoration, Wall of Force.

features.name: Restore Balance
features.text: As a reaction, cancel advantage or disadvantage on a roll of a creature within 60 feet. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Bastion of Law
features.text: Spend 1 to 5 sorcery points to give a creature that many d8s to reduce damage.

features.name: Trance of Order
features.text: As a bonus action, for 1 minute attacks against you can't have advantage and your d20 rolls of 9 or lower count as 10. Once per long rest or 5 sorcery points.

features.name: Clockwork Cavalcade
features.text: As an action, summon spirits in a 30-foot cube that heal 100 HP, repair objects and end spells of 6th level or lower. Once per long rest or 7 sorcery points.

features.name: Dragon Ancestor
features.text: Choose a dragon type for its damage type; you speak Draconic and double proficiency on Charisma checks with dragons.

features.name: Draconic Resilience
features.text: Your HP maximum increases by 1 per sorcerer level, and without armor your AC is 13 + Dexterity modifier (use Mage Armor mode in Editar).

features.name: Elemental Affinity
features.text: Add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of spells of your ancestry's type, and spend 1 sorcery point for resistance to it for 1 hour.

features.name: Dragon Wings
features.text: As a bonus action, sprout wings and gain a flying speed equal to your speed.

features.name: Draconic Presence
features.text: Spend 5 sorcery points for a 60-foot aura that charms or frightens creatures for 1 minute on a failed Wisdom save.

features.name: Divine Magic
features.text: You can learn cleric spells as sorcerer spells, and gain one bonus spell based on your affinity (good, evil, law, chaos or neutrality).

features.name: Favored by the Gods
features.text: When you fail a save or miss an attack, add 2d4 to the roll. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Empowered Healing
features.text: Spend 1 sorcery point to reroll healing dice for you or an ally within 5 feet. Once per turn.

features.name: Otherworldly Wings
features.text: As a bonus action, gain a 30-foot flying speed.

features.name: Unearthly Recovery
features.text: As a bonus action when below half HP, regain half your HP maximum. Once per long rest.

features.name: Lunar Embodiment
features.text: Learn spells by moon phase (Full Moon, New Moon, Crescent Moon) and choose a phase after each rest; you can cast one of that phase's 1st-level spells free once per long rest.

features.name: Moon Fire
features.text: You learn Sacred Flame, and it can target two creatures within 5 feet of each other.

features.name: Lunar Boons
features.text: Spend less sorcery points on Metamagic for spells of your current phase's schools. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Waxing and Waning
features.text: As a bonus action, spend 1 sorcery point to change your lunar phase.

features.name: Lunar Empowerment
features.text: Gain a passive benefit from your current phase (bright light, advantage on Stealth, or resistance to radiant and necrotic).

features.name: Lunar Phenomenon
features.text: As a bonus action, unleash your phase's power (heal and blind, invisible teleport, or resistance and teleport). Once per long rest or 5 sorcery points.

features.name: Eyes of the Dark
features.text: Darkvision 120 feet; from 3rd level, cast Darkness for 2 sorcery points and see through it.

features.name: Strength of the Grave
features.text: When reduced to 0 HP (not by radiant or a critical), make a Charisma save to drop to 1 HP instead. Once per long rest.

features.name: Hound of Ill Omen
features.text: As a bonus action, spend 3 sorcery points to summon a hound that hunts a creature; it has disadvantage on saves against your spells while the hound is near.

features.name: Shadow Walk
features.text: As a bonus action in dim light or darkness, teleport up to 120 feet to another dim or dark space.

features.name: Umbral Form
features.text: Spend 6 sorcery points to become shadowy for 1 minute: resist all damage but force and radiant and move through creatures and objects.

features.name: Wind Speaker
features.text: You speak Primordial and its dialects.

features.name: Tempestuous Magic
features.text: Before or after casting a 1st-level or higher spell, fly up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Heart of the Storm
features.text: Resistance to lightning and thunder; when you cast a lightning or thunder spell, nearby creatures take damage equal to half your sorcerer level.

features.name: Storm Guide
features.text: Stop rain around you or control the direction of wind as an action.

features.name: Storm's Fury
features.text: When hit by a melee attack, use your reaction to deal lightning damage equal to your sorcerer level and push the attacker 20 feet.

features.name: Wind Soul
features.text: Immunity to lightning and thunder, a 60-foot flying speed, and you can share flight with allies for 1 hour once per short rest.

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.text: After you cast a 1st-level or higher sorcerer spell, the DM can have you roll a d20; on a 1, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table.

features.name: Tides of Chaos
features.text: Gain advantage on one attack, check or save. It recharges on a long rest or after a Wild Magic Surge.

features.name: Bend Luck
features.text: As a reaction, spend 2 sorcery points to add or subtract 1d4 from another creature's attack, check or save.

features.name: Controlled Chaos
features.text: When you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, roll twice and use either result.

features.name: Spell Bombardment
features.text: When you roll damage for a spell and get the maximum on a die, roll it again and add it, once per turn.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.text: 1st: Faerie Fire, Sleep. 2nd: Calm Emotions, Phantasmal Force. 3rd: Blink, Plant Growth. 4th: Dominate Beast, Greater Invisibility. 5th: Dominate Person, Seeming.

features.name: Fey Presence
features.text: As an action, creatures in a 10-foot cube from you make a Wisdom save or are charmed or frightened by you until the end of your next turn. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Misty Escape
features.text: When you take damage, use your reaction to turn invisible and teleport up to 60 feet. You stay invisible until your next turn starts or you attack or cast. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Beguiling Defenses
features.text: You are immune to being charmed. When someone tries to charm you, your reaction can turn it back on them with a Wisdom save, charming them for 1 minute.

features.name: Dark Delirium
features.text: As an action, a creature within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save or is charmed or frightened for 1 minute, lost in an illusion. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.text: 1st: Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt. 2nd: Flaming Sphere, Lesser Restoration. 3rd: Daylight, Revivify. 4th: Guardian of Faith, Wall of Fire. 5th: Flame Strike, Greater Restoration.

features.name: Bonus Cantrips
features.text: You learn Light and Sacred Flame; they count as warlock cantrips but not against your cantrips known.

features.name: Healing Light
features.text: You have a pool of d6s equal to 1 + your warlock level. As a bonus action, heal a creature within 60 feet by spending dice, up to your Charisma modifier per use. Recharges on a long rest.

features.name: Radiant Soul
features.text: You gain resistance to radiant damage. Add your Charisma modifier to one radiant or fire damage roll of your spells against one target.

features.name: Celestial Resilience
features.text: When you finish a short or long rest, gain temp HP equal to warlock level + Charisma modifier, and up to five creatures gain half that.

features.name: Searing Vengeance
features.text: When you make a death save at the start of your turn, you can instead rise with half your HP max and blast nearby enemies with radiant damage, blinding them. Once per long rest.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.text: 1st: Create or Destroy Water, Thunderwave. 2nd: Gust of Wind, Silence. 3rd: Lightning Bolt, Sleet Storm. 4th: Control Water, Summon Elemental (water only). 5th: Bigby's Hand, Cone of Cold.

features.name: Tentacle of the Deep
features.text: As a bonus action, summon a spectral tentacle that makes a cold-damage spell attack and reduces the target's speed. Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Gift of the Sea
features.text: You gain a 40-foot swimming speed and can breathe underwater.

features.name: Oceanic Soul
features.text: You gain resistance to cold damage. While fully submerged, you and other submerged creatures understand each other.

features.name: Guardian Coil
features.text: Use your reaction to reduce damage dealt to a creature near your tentacle by 1d8 (2d8 at 10th level).

features.name: Grasping Tentacles
features.text: You learn Evard's Black Tentacles and can cast it once per long rest without a slot. Casting it grants temp HP and damage can't break its concentration.

features.name: Fathomless Plunge
features.text: As an action, teleport yourself and up to five willing creatures to a body of water you've seen within 1 mile. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.text: 1st: Burning Hands, Command. 2nd: Blindness/Deafness, Scorching Ray. 3rd: Fireball, Stinking Cloud. 4th: Fire Shield, Wall of Fire. 5th: Flame Strike, Hallow.

features.name: Dark One's Blessing
features.text: When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 HP, gain temp HP equal to your Charisma modifier + warlock level (minimum 1).

features.name: Dark One's Own Luck
features.text: Add a d10 to an ability check or saving throw after seeing the roll but before the outcome. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Fiendish Resilience
features.text: After a rest, choose a damage type to resist until you choose another. Magical or silvered weapons ignore it.

features.name: Hurl Through Hell
features.text: When you hit a creature, send it through the lower planes until the end of your next turn; non-fiends take 10d10 psychic damage. Once per long rest.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.text: Detect Evil and Good, Phantasmal Force, Create Food and Water, Phantasmal Killer, Creation and Wish, plus extra spells set by your genie kind (Dao, Djinni, Efreeti or Marid).

features.name: Genie's Vessel
features.text: You receive a Tiny vessel that is your spellcasting focus. If it is lost, a 1-hour ceremony during a rest gives you a new one.

features.name: Bottled Respite
features.text: As an action, vanish into your vessel's extradimensional space for up to twice your proficiency bonus in hours. Once per long rest.

features.name: Genie's Wrath
features.text: Once per turn, when you hit with an attack roll, deal extra damage equal to your proficiency bonus of your genie kind's type.

invocations.name: Chains of Carceri
invocations.text: Cast Hold Monster at will on a celestial, fiend or elemental without a slot; once per creature per long rest.

invocations.name: Devil's Sight
invocations.text: See normally in magical and nonmagical darkness out to 120 feet.

invocations.name: Dreadful Word
invocations.text: Cast Confusion once using a Pact Magic slot. Once per long rest.

invocations.name: Eldritch Sight
invocations.text: Cast Detect Magic at will without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Eldritch Spear
invocations.text: Eldritch Blast has a range of 300 feet.

invocations.name: Eyes of the Rune Keeper
invocations.text: You can read all writing.

invocations.name: Fiendish Vigor
invocations.text: Cast False Life on yourself at will as a 1st-level spell without a slot.

invocations.name: Gaze of Two Minds
invocations.text: As an action, touch a willing humanoid and perceive through its senses until the end of your next turn.

invocations.name: Lifedrinker
invocations.text: Your pact weapon hits deal extra necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier.

invocations.name: Mask of Many Faces
invocations.text: Cast Disguise Self at will without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Master of Myriad Forms
invocations.text: Cast Alter Self at will without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Minions of Chaos
invocations.text: Cast Conjure Elemental once using a Pact Magic slot. Once per long rest.

invocations.name: Mire the Mind
invocations.text: Cast Slow once using a Pact Magic slot. Once per long rest.

invocations.name: Misty Visions
invocations.text: Cast Silent Image at will without a spell slot.

invocations.name: One with Shadows
invocations.text: In dim light or darkness, use your action to become invisible until you move or act.

invocations.name: Otherworldly Leap
invocations.text: Cast Jump on yourself at will without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Repelling Blast
invocations.text: When an Eldritch Blast beam hits, push the creature up to 10 feet away.

invocations.name: Sculptor of Flesh
invocations.text: Cast Polymorph once using a Pact Magic slot. Once per long rest.

invocations.name: Sign of Ill Omen
invocations.text: Cast Bestow Curse once using a Pact Magic slot. Once per long rest.

invocations.name: Thief of Five Fates
invocations.text: Cast Bane once using a Pact Magic slot. Once per long rest.

invocations.name: Thirsting Blade
invocations.text: Attack twice with your pact weapon when you take the Attack action.

invocations.name: Visions of Distant Realms
invocations.text: Cast Arcane Eye at will without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Voice of the Chain Master
invocations.text: Communicate telepathically with your familiar and perceive through its senses at any distance on the same plane.

invocations.name: Whispers of the Grave
invocations.text: Cast Speak with Dead at will without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Witch Sight
invocations.text: See the true form of shapechangers and creatures concealed by illusion or transmutation within 30 feet.

invocations.name: Aspect of the Moon
invocations.text: You don't need to sleep; you can rest with light activity only.

invocations.name: Cloak of Flies
invocations.text: As a bonus action, surround yourself with a 5-foot aura of flies: advantage on Intimidation, disadvantage on other Charisma checks, and poison damage to creatures that start their turn in it. Once per short or long rest.

invocations.name: Eldritch Smite
invocations.text: Once per turn when you hit with your pact weapon, spend a Pact Magic slot for 1d8 force damage plus 1d8 per slot level, and knock a Huge or smaller target prone.

invocations.name: Ghostly Gaze
invocations.text: As an action, see through solid objects to 30 feet for 1 minute (concentration). Once per short or long rest.

invocations.name: Gift of the Depths
invocations.text: Breathe underwater, gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed, and cast Water Breathing once per long rest without a slot.

invocations.name: Gift of the Ever-Living Ones
invocations.text: When you regain HP while your familiar is within 100 feet, treat any dice rolled as their maximum.

invocations.name: Grasp of Hadar
invocations.text: Once per turn when Eldritch Blast hits, pull the creature 10 feet closer to you.

invocations.name: Improved Pact Weapon
invocations.text: Your pact weapon is a focus, gets +1 to attack and damage if not already magical, and can be a shortbow, longbow or crossbow.

invocations.name: Lance of Lethargy
invocations.text: Once per turn when Eldritch Blast hits, reduce the creature's speed by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.

invocations.name: Maddening Hex
invocations.prerequisite: 5th level, Hex spell or a warlock feature that curses
invocations.text: As a bonus action, creatures within 5 feet of your cursed target take psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier.

invocations.name: Relentless Hex
invocations.prerequisite: 7th level, Hex spell or a warlock feature that curses
invocations.text: As a bonus action, teleport up to 30 feet to a space within 5 feet of your cursed target.

invocations.name: Shroud of Shadow
invocations.text: Cast Invisibility at will without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Tomb of Levistus
invocations.text: As a reaction when you take damage, encase yourself in ice: gain 10 temp HP per warlock level but become incapacitated with speed 0 until the end of your next turn. Once per short or long rest.

invocations.name: Trickster's Escape
invocations.text: Cast Freedom of Movement on yourself once using a Pact Magic slot. Once per long rest.

invocations.name: Bond of the Talisman
invocations.text: The wearer of your talisman can teleport to you as an action, or you to them. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

invocations.name: Eldritch Mind
invocations.text: Advantage on Constitution saves to maintain concentration.

invocations.name: Far Scribe
invocations.text: Creatures who write their names in your book can receive your Sending without a slot.

invocations.name: Gift of the Protectors
invocations.text: Creatures who write their names in your book drop to 1 HP instead of 0, once each per long rest.

invocations.name: Investment of the Chain Master
invocations.text: Your familiar gains a flying or swimming speed, attacks with your bonus action command, magical weapon attacks, your save DC, and you can give it resistance.

invocations.name: Protection of the Talisman
invocations.text: The wearer adds 1d4 to failed saving throws. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

invocations.name: Rebuke of the Talisman
invocations.text: When the wearer is hit by a creature within 30 feet, use your reaction to deal psychic damage equal to your proficiency bonus and push it 10 feet.

invocations.name: Undying Servitude
invocations.text: Cast Animate Dead without a slot once per long rest.

items.name: Lance
items.text: Disadvantage when attacking a target within 5 feet; two hands needed unless mounted.

items.text: Firearm from the Dungeon Master's Guide (Renaissance). Needs the DM's approval and firearm proficiency.

items.name: Alchemist's Fire (flask)

items.name: Antitoxin (vial)
items.text: Advantage on saves against poison for 1 hour.

items.name: Backpack
items.text: Holds 1 cubic foot or 30 lb of gear.

items.name: Ball Bearings (bag of 1,000)
items.text: Cover a 10-foot square; creatures moving through must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity save or fall prone.

items.name: Block and Tackle
items.text: Lets you hoist up to four times the weight you can normally lift.

items.name: Caltrops (bag of 20)

items.name: Candle

items.name: Case, Crossbow Bolt

items.name: Component Pouch

items.name: Crowbar
items.text: Advantage on Strength checks where leverage helps.

items.name: Healer's Kit

items.name: Holy Water (flask)
items.text: Throw it (20 ft): 2d6 radiant damage to a fiend or undead on a hit.

items.name: Hunting Trap

items.name: Lamp
items.text: Bright light 15 ft and dim light 30 ft for 6 hours per flask of oil.

items.name: Lantern, Bullseye

items.name: Lantern, Hooded
items.text: Bright light 30 ft and dim light 30 more feet; can be lowered to dim light 5 ft.

items.name: Oil (flask)
items.text: Can be thrown and set alight to burn for 5 fire damage.

items.name: Poison, Basic (vial)
items.text: Coat a weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition: 1d4 poison damage on a hit (DC 10 Constitution save).

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.text: Regain 2d4 + 2 hit points.

items.name: Quiver
items.text: Holds up to 20 arrows.

items.name: Ram, Portable
items.text: +4 to Strength checks to break doors.

items.name: Torch
items.text: Bright light 20 ft and dim light 20 more feet for 1 hour.

items.name: Net
items.text: Throw it at a Large or smaller creature (range 5/15): it is restrained until freed (DC 10 Strength check or 5 slashing damage to the net).

items.name: Firearm Bullets (10)
items.text: Ammunition for DMG firearms.

items.name: Burglar's Pack
items.text: Backpack, ball bearings, string, bell, candles, crowbar, hammer, pitons, hooded lantern, oil, rations, tinderbox, waterskin and rope.

items.name: Diplomat's Pack
items.text: Chest, map cases, fine clothes, ink, pen, lamp, oil, paper, perfume, sealing wax and soap.

items.name: Dungeoneer's Pack
items.text: Backpack, crowbar, hammer, pitons, torches, tinderbox, rations, waterskin and rope.

items.name: Entertainer's Pack
items.text: Backpack, bedroll, costumes, candles, rations, waterskin and a disguise kit.

items.name: Explorer's Pack
items.text: Backpack, bedroll, mess kit, tinderbox, torches, rations, waterskin and rope.

items.name: Priest's Pack
items.text: Backpack, blanket, candles, tinderbox, alms box, incense, censer, vestments, rations and waterskin.

items.name: Scholar's Pack
items.text: Backpack, book of lore, ink, pen, parchment, sand and a small knife.

options.name: Archery
options.text: +2 to attack rolls with ranged weapons.

options.name: Blind Fighting
options.text: Blindsight out to 10 feet.

options.name: Blessed Warrior
options.text: Learn two cleric cantrips; they count as paladin spells and use Charisma.

options.name: Defense
options.text: +1 AC while you wear armor.

options.name: Druidic Warrior
options.text: Learn two druid cantrips; they count as ranger spells and use Wisdom.

options.name: Dueling
options.text: +2 damage with a melee weapon held in one hand when you wield no other weapon.

options.name: Great Weapon Fighting
options.text: Reroll 1s and 2s on damage dice of two-handed or versatile melee weapons used with two hands.

options.name: Interception
options.text: With a shield or weapon in hand, use your reaction to reduce damage to a nearby ally by 1d10 + proficiency bonus.

options.name: Protection
options.text: With a shield, use your reaction to impose disadvantage on an attack against an ally within 5 feet.

options.name: Superior Technique
options.text: Learn one maneuver and gain one d6 superiority die that returns on a short or long rest.

options.name: Thrown Weapon Fighting
options.text: Draw a thrown weapon as part of the attack, and +2 damage on ranged attacks with thrown weapons.

options.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
options.text: Add your ability modifier to the damage of your off-hand attack.

options.name: Unarmed Fighting
options.text: Unarmed strikes deal 1d6 (1d8 with both hands free), and you deal 1d4 bludgeoning to a creature you grapple each turn.

options.name: Ambush
options.text: Add a superiority die to a Stealth check or initiative roll.

options.name: Bait and Switch
options.text: Swap places with an ally within 5 feet using 5 feet of movement; one of you adds the die to AC until your next turn.

options.name: Brace
options.text: When a creature moves into your reach, use your reaction to attack it, adding the die to damage.

options.name: Commander's Strike
options.text: Give up one attack so an ally can use its reaction to attack, adding the die to its damage.

options.name: Commanding Presence
options.text: Add a superiority die to an Intimidation, Performance or Persuasion check.

options.name: Disarming Attack
options.text: Add the die to damage; the target makes a Strength save or drops an item it holds.

options.name: Distracting Strike
options.text: Add the die to damage; the next ally attack against the target before your next turn has advantage.

options.name: Evasive Footwork
options.text: When you move, add the die to your AC until you stop moving.

options.name: Feinting Attack
options.text: As a bonus action, gain advantage on your next attack against a creature within 5 feet and add the die to its damage.

options.name: Goading Attack
options.text: Add the die to damage; the target makes a Wisdom save or has disadvantage attacking anyone but you.

options.name: Grappling Strike
options.text: After hitting with a melee attack, try to grapple as a bonus action, adding the die to the Athletics check.

options.name: Lunging Attack
options.text: Increase your reach by 5 feet for one melee attack and add the die to its damage.

options.name: Maneuvering Attack
options.text: Add the die to damage; an ally can use its reaction to move half its speed without provoking from the target.

options.name: Menacing Attack
options.text: Add the die to damage; the target makes a Wisdom save or is frightened until your next turn ends.

options.name: Parry
options.text: When hit by a melee attack, use your reaction to reduce the damage by the die + Dexterity modifier.

options.name: Precision Attack
options.text: Add the die to a weapon attack roll, before or after rolling but before the result.

options.name: Pushing Attack
options.text: Add the die to damage; a Large or smaller target makes a Strength save or is pushed 15 feet.

options.name: Quick Toss
options.text: As a bonus action, draw and throw a thrown weapon, adding the die to its damage.

options.name: Rally
options.text: As a bonus action, an ally who can hear you gains temp HP equal to the die + Charisma modifier.

options.name: Riposte
options.text: When a creature misses you in melee, use your reaction to attack it, adding the die to damage.

options.name: Sweeping Attack
options.text: When you hit, another creature within 5 feet of you and the target takes the die as damage if your roll would hit it.

options.name: Tactical Assessment
options.text: Add a superiority die to an Investigation, History or Insight check.

options.name: Trip Attack
options.text: Add the die to damage; a Large or smaller target makes a Strength save or is knocked prone.

options.name: Banishing Arrow
options.text: The target makes a Charisma save or is banished to the Feywild until your next turn ends (2d6 force at 18th).

options.name: Beguiling Arrow
options.text: Extra 2d6 psychic damage; the target makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by an ally you choose.

options.name: Bursting Arrow
options.text: The arrow explodes: the target and creatures within 10 feet take 2d6 force damage.

options.name: Enfeebling Arrow
options.text: Extra 2d6 necrotic damage; the target makes a Constitution save or deals half damage with weapons.

options.name: Grasping Arrow
options.text: Extra 2d6 poison damage; brambles slow the target and hurt it when it moves until removed.

options.name: Piercing Arrow
options.text: The arrow passes through objects in a 30-foot line; each creature in it makes a Dexterity save or takes the weapon damage + 1d6 piercing.

options.name: Seeking Arrow
options.text: Choose a creature you've seen in the last minute; it makes a Dexterity save or takes the damage + 1d6 force and you learn its location.

options.name: Shadow Arrow
options.text: Extra 2d6 psychic damage; the target makes a Wisdom save or can't see beyond 5 feet until your next turn.

options.name: Cloud Rune
options.text: Advantage on Sleight of Hand and Deception. Activated: redirect an attack that hits a creature near you to another creature.

options.name: Fire Rune
options.text: Double proficiency with tools. Activated: when you hit, fiery shackles deal 2d6 fire and restrain the target on a failed Strength save.

options.name: Frost Rune
options.text: Advantage on Animal Handling and Intimidation. Activated: +2 to Strength and Constitution checks and saves for 10 minutes.

options.name: Stone Rune
options.text: Advantage on Insight and darkvision 120 feet. Activated: charm a creature within 30 feet into a dreamy stupor on a failed Wisdom save.

options.name: Hill Rune
options.text: Advantage against being poisoned and resistance to poison. Activated: resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing for 1 minute.

options.name: Storm Rune
options.text: Advantage on Arcana and can't be surprised. Activated: for 1 minute, use your reaction to give advantage or disadvantage on rolls near you.

options.name: Careful Spell
options.text: 1 point: up to Charisma modifier creatures automatically succeed on the spell's save.

options.name: Distant Spell
options.text: 1 point: double the spell's range, or make a touch spell reach 30 feet.

options.name: Empowered Spell
options.text: 1 point: reroll up to Charisma modifier damage dice. Can combine with another option.

options.name: Extended Spell
options.text: 1 point: double a duration of 1 minute or longer, up to 24 hours.

options.name: Heightened Spell
options.text: 3 points: one target has disadvantage on its first save against the spell.

options.name: Quickened Spell
options.text: 2 points: cast a spell with a casting time of 1 action as a bonus action.

options.name: Seeking Spell
options.text: 2 points: reroll the d20 of a missed spell attack.

options.name: Subtle Spell
options.text: 1 point: cast without verbal or somatic components.

options.name: Transmuted Spell
options.text: 1 point: change the damage type to acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison or thunder.

options.name: Twinned Spell
options.text: Points equal to the spell's level (1 for cantrips): target a second creature with a single-target spell.

options.name: Armor of Magical Strength
options.text: Armor with charges: add a charge as bonus to Strength checks and saves, or avoid being knocked prone.

options.name: Boots of the Winding Path
options.text: As a bonus action, teleport back to a space you occupied this turn.

options.name: Enhanced Arcane Focus
options.text: +1 to spell attacks (+2 at 10th level) and ignore half cover.

options.name: Enhanced Defense
options.text: Armor or shield gains +1 AC (+2 at 10th level).

options.name: Enhanced Weapon
options.text: A simple or martial weapon gains +1 to attack and damage (+2 at 10th level).

options.name: Helm of Awareness
options.text: Advantage on initiative and you can't be surprised while not incapacitated.

options.name: Homunculus Servant
options.text: Create a homunculus companion from a gem worth 100 gp.

options.name: Mind Sharpener
options.text: Armor or robes with charges: spend one to succeed on a failed concentration save.

options.name: Radiant Weapon
options.text: +1 weapon that sheds light; as a reaction when hit, blind the attacker on a failed Constitution save.

options.name: Repeating Shot
options.text: +1 ranged weapon that ignores loading and makes its own ammunition.

options.name: Replicate Magic Item
options.text: Learn a magic item plan (Bag of Holding, Goggles of Night, Sending Stones...) and make it with an infusion. Can be taken several times.
