options.name: Repulsion Shield
options.text: +1 shield; as a reaction when hit in melee, push the attacker 15 feet.

options.name: Resistant Armor
options.text: Armor grants resistance to one damage type you choose.

options.name: Returning Weapon
options.text: +1 thrown weapon that flies back to your hand after the attack.

options.name: Spell-Refueling Ring
options.text: Once per long rest, regain a spell slot of 3rd level or lower.

options.name: Elemental Attunement
options.text: Free: create minor elemental effects (sparks, breezes, small flames, shaped water or earth).

options.name: Breath of Winter
options.text: 6 ki: cast Cone of Cold.

options.name: Clench of the North Wind
options.text: 3 ki: cast Hold Person.

options.name: Eternal Mountain Defense
options.text: 5 ki: cast Stoneskin on yourself.

options.name: Fangs of the Fire Snake
options.text: 1 ki: your unarmed strikes reach 10 feet this turn and deal fire damage; 1 more ki adds 1d10 fire to a hit.

options.name: Fist of Four Thunders
options.text: 2 ki: cast Thunderwave.

options.name: Fist of Unbroken Air
options.text: 2 ki: a creature within 30 feet takes 3d10 bludgeoning, is pushed 20 feet and knocked prone on a failed Strength save.

options.name: Flames of the Phoenix
options.text: 4 ki: cast Fireball.

options.name: Gong of the Summit
options.text: 3 ki: cast Shatter.

options.name: Mist Stance
options.text: 4 ki: cast Gaseous Form on yourself.

options.name: Ride the Wind
options.text: 4 ki: cast Fly on yourself.

options.name: River of Hungry Flame
options.text: 5 ki: cast Wall of Fire.

options.name: Rush of the Gale Spirits
options.text: 2 ki: cast Gust of Wind.

options.name: Shape the Flowing River
options.text: 1 ki: reshape or move water and ice within 120 feet.

options.name: Sweeping Cinder Strike
options.text: 2 ki: cast Burning Hands.

options.name: Water Whip
options.text: 2 ki: a creature within 30 feet takes 3d10 bludgeoning and is pulled 25 feet or knocked prone on a failed Dexterity save.

options.name: Wave of Rolling Earth
options.text: 6 ki: cast Wall of Stone.

options.name: Colossus Slayer
options.text: Once per turn, a weapon hit on a creature below its HP maximum deals an extra 1d8.

options.name: Giant Killer
options.text: When a Large or larger creature within 5 feet attacks you, use your reaction to attack it.

options.name: Horde Breaker
options.text: Once per turn, make another attack against a different creature within 5 feet of the original target.

options.name: Escape the Horde
options.text: Opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage.

options.name: Multiattack Defense
options.text: After a creature hits you, you gain +4 AC against its other attacks this turn.

options.name: Steel Will
options.text: Advantage on saves against being frightened.

options.name: Volley
options.text: As an action, make a ranged attack against any number of creatures within 10 feet of a point.

options.name: Whirlwind Attack
options.text: As an action, make a melee attack against every creature within 5 feet.

options.name: Evasion
options.text: On a Dexterity save for half damage, take none on a success and half on a failure.

options.name: Stand Against the Tide
options.text: When a melee attack misses you, use your reaction to make it hit another creature of your choice.

options.name: Uncanny Dodge
options.text: When an attacker you can see hits you, use your reaction to halve the damage.

options.name: Bear
options.text: While raging, resistance to all damage except psychic.

options.name: Eagle
options.text: While raging without heavy armor, opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage and you can Dash as a bonus action.

options.name: Elk
options.text: While raging without heavy armor, your walking speed increases by 15 feet.

options.name: Tiger
options.text: While raging, long jumps gain 10 feet and high jumps 3 feet.

options.name: Wolf
options.text: While raging, allies have advantage on melee attacks against enemies within 5 feet of you.

options.name: Bear
options.text: Double carrying capacity and advantage on Strength checks to push, pull, lift or break.

options.name: Eagle
options.text: See up to a mile away clearly, and dim light doesn't hinder your Perception.

options.name: Elk
options.text: You and up to ten companions travel at double pace.

options.name: Tiger
options.text: Proficiency in two of Athletics, Acrobatics, Stealth and Survival.

options.name: Wolf
options.text: Track at a fast pace and move stealthily at a normal pace.

options.name: Bear
options.text: While raging, enemies within 5 feet have disadvantage attacking anyone but you.

options.name: Eagle
options.text: While raging, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed.

options.name: Elk
options.text: While raging, as a bonus action move through a Large or smaller creature's space; it makes a Strength save or is knocked prone and takes damage.

options.name: Tiger
options.text: While raging, after moving 20 feet straight toward a target, make one extra melee attack as a bonus action.

options.name: Wolf
options.text: While raging, when you hit with a melee attack, knock a Large or smaller creature prone as a bonus action.

options.name: Desert
options.text: Aura deals fire damage to creatures when you activate it; later, resistance to fire.

options.name: Sea
options.text: Aura strikes one creature with lightning on a failed Dexterity save; later, resistance to lightning.

options.name: Tundra
options.text: Aura gives temp HP to you and allies; later, resistance to cold.

spells.name: Acid Splash
spells.text: One creature, or two within 5 feet of each other, make a Dexterity save or take 1d6 acid damage.
spells.higher: 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at 11, 4d6 at 17.

spells.name: Blade Ward
spells.text: Until the end of your next turn, you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from weapon attacks.

spells.name: Booming Blade
spells.text: Make a melee attack with a weapon worth 1+ sp as part of casting. On a hit the target suffers the normal effects and is sheathed in thunder: if it willingly moves before your next turn, it takes 1d8 thunder damage.
spells.higher: At level 5 the hit deals +1d8 thunder and the move damage is 2d8; both rise by 1d8 at 11 and 17.

spells.name: Chill Touch
spells.text: Ranged spell attack for 1d8 necrotic damage; the target can't regain HP until your next turn, and an undead target has disadvantage on attacks against you.
spells.higher: 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11, 4d8 at 17.

spells.name: Control Flames
spells.text: Shape nonmagical fire within a 5-foot cube: spread it, extinguish it, change its brightness or color, or make simple shapes in it for 1 hour.

spells.name: Create Bonfire
spells.text: A bonfire fills a 5-foot cube. A creature in it when it appears or that moves into it makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d8 fire damage.
spells.higher: 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11, 4d8 at 17.

spells.name: Dancing Lights
spells.text: Up to four torch-sized lights (or one Medium glowing humanoid form) shed dim light in 10 feet. As a bonus action move them up to 60 feet; they stay within 20 feet of each other.

spells.name: Druidcraft
spells.text: Predict the weather for 24 hours, make a flower bloom or seed open, create a harmless sensory effect, or light or snuff a small flame.

spells.name: Eldritch Blast
spells.text: A beam of crackling energy: ranged spell attack for 1d10 force damage.
spells.higher: Two beams at level 5, three at 11, four at 17, each with its own attack roll.

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.text: Ranged spell attack for 1d10 fire damage. Flammable unattended objects ignite.
spells.higher: 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at 11, 4d10 at 17.

spells.name: Friends
spells.text: You have advantage on Charisma checks against one non-hostile creature. When the spell ends, it realizes you used magic and may become hostile.

spells.name: Frostbite
spells.text: A creature makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 cold damage and has disadvantage on its next weapon attack roll before the end of its next turn.
spells.higher: 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at 11, 4d6 at 17.

spells.name: Green-Flame Blade
spells.text: Make a melee attack with a weapon worth 1+ sp as part of casting. On a hit, green fire leaps to a different creature within 5 feet of the target, dealing fire damage equal to your spellcasting modifier.
spells.higher: At level 5 the hit deals +1d8 fire and the leap deals 1d8 + modifier; both rise by 1d8 at 11 and 17.

spells.name: Guidance
spells.text: A willing creature can add 1d4 to one ability check of its choice before the spell ends.

spells.name: Gust
spells.text: Push a Medium or smaller creature 5 feet (Strength save), push an unattended object up to 5 pounds 10 feet, or create a harmless sensory effect with air.

spells.name: Infestation
spells.text: Mites swarm a creature: Constitution save or 1d6 poison damage and it moves 5 feet in a random direction.
spells.higher: 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at 11, 4d6 at 17.

spells.name: Light
spells.text: An object sheds bright light in 20 feet and dim light 20 more. An object held by a hostile creature requires a Dexterity save to avoid.

spells.name: Lightning Lure
spells.text: A creature within 15 feet makes a Strength save or is pulled 10 feet toward you, taking 1d8 lightning damage if it ends within 5 feet of you.
spells.higher: 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11, 4d8 at 17.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.text: A spectral hand manipulates objects, opens unlocked doors and containers, stows or retrieves items, or pours a vial (up to 10 pounds). It can't attack or activate magic items.

spells.name: Magic Stone
spells.text: Imbue up to three pebbles. You or someone else can throw or sling them as a ranged spell attack, using your spellcasting modifier, for 1d6 + your spellcasting modifier bludgeoning damage.

spells.name: Mending
spells.text: Repair a single break or tear in an object, such as a broken chain link or a torn cloak, no larger than 1 foot in any dimension.

spells.name: Message
spells.text: Whisper a message to a creature in range that only it hears; it can reply in a whisper. Blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, thin lead or 3 feet of wood.

spells.name: Mind Sliver
spells.text: A creature makes an Intelligence save or takes 1d6 psychic damage and subtracts 1d4 from its next saving throw before the end of your next turn.
spells.higher: 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at 11, 4d6 at 17.

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.text: Create a sound or an image of an object no larger than a 5-foot cube. An Intelligence (Investigation) check against your DC reveals it.

spells.name: Mold Earth
spells.text: Move loose earth in a 5-foot cube, make shapes or colors appear on dirt or stone for 1 hour, or turn the ground into difficult terrain (or back).

spells.name: Poison Spray
spells.text: A creature makes a Constitution save or takes 1d12 poison damage.
spells.higher: 2d12 at level 5, 3d12 at 11, 4d12 at 17.

spells.name: Prestidigitation
spells.text: Minor magical tricks: sensory effects, light or snuff a candle, clean or soil, chill or warm, flavor, make a small mark, or a trinket illusion. Up to three effects at once.

spells.name: Primal Savagery
spells.text: Your teeth or nails sharpen: melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet for 1d10 acid damage.
spells.higher: 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at 11, 4d10 at 17.

spells.name: Produce Flame
spells.text: A flame in your hand sheds light. You can hurl it (when cast or as an action later) as a ranged spell attack within 30 feet for 1d8 fire damage.
spells.higher: 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11, 4d8 at 17.

spells.name: Ray of Frost
spells.text: Ranged spell attack for 1d8 cold damage, and the target's speed drops by 10 feet until your next turn.
spells.higher: 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11, 4d8 at 17.

spells.name: Resistance
spells.text: A willing creature can add 1d4 to one saving throw of its choice before the spell ends.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.text: A creature makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d8 radiant damage, gaining no benefit from cover.
spells.higher: 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11, 4d8 at 17.

spells.name: Sapping Sting
spells.text: A creature makes a Constitution save or takes 1d4 necrotic damage and falls prone.
spells.higher: 2d4 at level 5, 3d4 at 11, 4d4 at 17.

spells.name: Shape Water
spells.text: Control water in a 5-foot cube: move it, form simple shapes, change its color or opacity, or freeze it (no creatures in it). Up to two non-instant effects.

spells.name: Shillelagh
spells.text: Your club or quarterstaff uses your spellcasting ability for attack and damage, its damage die becomes a d8, and it is magical.

spells.name: Shocking Grasp
spells.text: Melee spell attack (advantage if the target wears metal armor) for 1d8 lightning damage; the target can't take reactions until its next turn.
spells.higher: 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11, 4d8 at 17.

spells.name: Spare the Dying
spells.text: A living creature at 0 hit points becomes stable.

spells.name: Sword Burst
spells.text: Each creature within 5 feet makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 force damage.
spells.higher: 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at 11, 4d6 at 17.

spells.name: Thaumaturgy
spells.text: Minor wonders: booming voice, flickering flames, harmless tremors, an ominous sound, doors flying open or slamming, altered eyes. Up to three at once.

spells.name: Thorn Whip
spells.text: Melee spell attack for 1d6 piercing damage; a Large or smaller target is pulled up to 10 feet toward you.
spells.higher: 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at 11, 4d6 at 17.

spells.name: Thunderclap
spells.text: Each creature within 5 feet makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 thunder damage. Audible 100 feet away.
spells.higher: 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at 11, 4d6 at 17.

spells.name: Toll the Dead
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save or takes 1d8 necrotic damage, or 1d12 if it is missing any hit points.
spells.higher: Two dice at level 5, three at 11, four at 17.

spells.name: True Strike
spells.text: On your next turn you gain advantage on your first attack roll against the target, if the spell hasn't ended.

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.text: A creature that hears you makes a Wisdom save or takes 1d4 psychic damage and has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.
spells.higher: 2d4 at level 5, 3d4 at 11, 4d4 at 17.

spells.name: Word of Radiance
spells.text: Each creature you choose within 5 feet makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 radiant damage.
spells.higher: 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at 11, 4d6 at 17.

spells.name: Absorb Elements
spells.text: When you take acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage, you gain resistance to that type until your next turn, and your first melee hit on your next turn deals an extra 1d6 of that type.
spells.higher: Extra damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Alarm
spells.text: Ward a door, window or area up to a 20-foot cube; a creature touching or entering it triggers a mental or audible alarm. You choose creatures that don't trigger it.

spells.name: Animal Friendship
spells.text: A beast with Intelligence 3 or less makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by you. It ends if you or allies harm it.
spells.higher: One additional beast per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Armor of Agathys
spells.text: You gain 5 temporary hit points. While you have them, a creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 5 cold damage.
spells.higher: Both increase by 5 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Arms of Hadar
spells.text: Each creature within 10 feet makes a Strength save, taking 2d6 necrotic damage and losing its reaction on a failure, or half damage on a success.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Bane
spells.text: Up to three creatures make a Charisma save; those that fail subtract 1d4 from attack rolls and saving throws.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Beast Bond
spells.text: A telepathic link with a friendly beast of Intelligence 3 or less. It can understand simple messages, and it has advantage on attacks against creatures within 5 feet of you that you can see.

spells.name: Bless
spells.text: Up to three creatures add 1d4 to their attack rolls and saving throws.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.text: Each creature in a 15-foot cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d6 fire damage (half on success). Flammable objects ignite.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Catapult
spells.text: Hurl an object of 1 to 5 pounds up to 90 feet in a line. A creature in its path makes a Dexterity save or takes 3d8 bludgeoning damage, stopping the object.
spells.higher: Weight limit grows by 5 pounds and damage by 1d8 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Cause Fear
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save or is frightened of you, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. Constructs and undead are immune.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Ceremony
spells.text: Perform a religious rite: Atonement, Bless Water, Coming of Age, Dedication, Funeral Rite or Wedding, each with a small lasting benefit. Material: silver powder worth 25 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Chaos Bolt
spells.text: Ranged spell attack for 2d8 + 1d6 damage; the d8s set the damage type. If both d8s match, the bolt leaps to another creature within 30 feet.
spells.higher: Each target takes 1d6 more per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Charm Person
spells.text: A humanoid makes a Wisdom save (advantage if you are fighting it) or is charmed by you. It knows when the spell ends.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Chromatic Orb
spells.text: Ranged spell attack for 3d8 damage of a type you choose: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison or thunder. Material: a diamond worth 50 gp.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Color Spray
spells.text: Roll 6d10: creatures in a 15-foot cone with the lowest current HP are blinded until your next turn, as long as their HP fits within the total.
spells.higher: 2d10 more per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Command
spells.text: Give a one-word command (approach, drop, flee, grovel, halt...). On a failed Wisdom save the creature obeys on its next turn.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Compelled Duel
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save or has disadvantage on attacks against others than you and must save to move more than 30 feet away from you.

spells.name: Comprehend Languages
spells.text: You understand any spoken language you hear and any written language you touch.

spells.name: Create or Destroy Water
spells.text: Create or destroy up to 10 gallons of water, or create rain or destroy fog in a 30-foot cube.
spells.higher: 10 more gallons or 5 feet more cube per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.text: A creature regains 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier hit points. No effect on undead or constructs.
spells.higher: Healing increases by 1d8 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Detect Evil and Good
spells.text: Sense aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead within 30 feet, and consecrated or desecrated places.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.text: Sense magic within 30 feet and see auras around magic creatures and objects, learning their school.

spells.name: Detect Poison and Disease
spells.text: Sense poisons, poisonous creatures and diseases within 30 feet and identify their kind.

spells.name: Disguise Self
spells.text: Change your appearance, clothing and gear, up to 1 foot taller or shorter. An Investigation check against your DC reveals it.

spells.name: Dissonant Whispers
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save: on a failure 3d6 psychic damage and it must use its reaction to move away from you; half damage on a success.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Distort Value
spells.text: Make an object up to 1 cubic foot appear to be worth twice or half its actual value to anyone who examines it.
spells.higher: The object can be larger per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Divine Favor
spells.text: Your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage on a hit.

spells.name: Earth Tremor
spells.text: Each creature within 10 feet makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage and falls prone. Loose ground becomes difficult terrain.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Ensnaring Strike
spells.text: Your next weapon hit makes the target attempt a Strength save or be restrained by thorny vines, taking 1d6 piercing damage at the start of each of its turns.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.text: Plants fill a 20-foot square as difficult terrain; creatures there make a Strength save or are restrained.

spells.name: Expeditious Retreat
spells.text: You can take the Dash action as a bonus action, starting when you cast it.

spells.name: Faerie Fire
spells.text: Creatures in a 20-foot cube make a Dexterity save or are outlined in light; attacks against them have advantage and they can't benefit from being invisible.

spells.name: False Life
spells.text: You gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points.
spells.higher: 5 more temporary hit points per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Feather Fall
spells.text: Up to five falling creatures descend 60 feet per round and take no falling damage.

spells.name: Find Familiar
spells.text: Summon a familiar (celestial, fey or fiend) in an animal form. It shares telepathy within 100 feet, can deliver touch spells and lets you use its senses. Material: 10 gp of charcoal, incense and herbs, consumed.

spells.name: Fog Cloud
spells.text: A 20-foot-radius sphere of fog makes the area heavily obscured.
spells.higher: Radius increases by 20 feet per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Frost Fingers
spells.text: Each creature in a 15-foot cone makes a Constitution save, taking 2d8 cold damage (half on success). Unattended water freezes.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Gift of Alacrity
spells.text: A willing creature adds 1d8 to its initiative rolls for the duration.

spells.name: Goodberry
spells.text: Up to ten berries appear; eating one restores 1 hit point and provides a day's nourishment. They lose potency after 24 hours.

spells.name: Grease
spells.text: A 10-foot square becomes difficult terrain; creatures there or entering make a Dexterity save or fall prone.

spells.name: Guiding Bolt
spells.text: Ranged spell attack for 4d6 radiant damage; the next attack roll against the target before your next turn has advantage.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Hail of Thorns
spells.text: Your next ranged weapon hit makes thorns burst: the target and creatures within 5 feet make a Dexterity save, taking 1d10 piercing damage (half on success).
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.text: A creature you can see regains 1d4 + your spellcasting modifier hit points.
spells.higher: Healing increases by 1d4 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Hellish Rebuke
spells.text: When a creature damages you, it makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d10 fire damage (half on success).
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Heroism
spells.text: A willing creature is immune to being frightened and gains temporary HP equal to your spellcasting modifier at the start of each of its turns.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Hex
spells.text: Curse a creature: your attacks deal it an extra 1d6 necrotic damage, and it has disadvantage on checks with one ability you choose. Move the curse with a bonus action if it drops to 0 HP.
spells.higher: Level 3-4: up to 8 hours. Level 5+: up to 24 hours.

spells.name: Hunter's Mark
spells.text: Mark a creature: your weapon attacks deal it an extra 1d6 damage and you have advantage on Perception and Survival checks to find it. Move the mark with a bonus action if it drops to 0 HP.
spells.higher: Level 3-4: up to 8 hours. Level 5+: up to 24 hours.

spells.name: Ice Knife
spells.text: Ranged spell attack for 1d10 piercing damage; hit or miss, it explodes and the target and creatures within 5 feet make a Dexterity save or take 2d6 cold damage.
spells.higher: Cold damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Identify
spells.text: Learn a magic item's properties, attunement need and charges, or which spells affect a creature or object. Material: a pearl worth 100 gp.

spells.name: Illusory Script
spells.text: Write a message only chosen creatures can read; others see gibberish or a false message. Material: ink worth 10 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Inflict Wounds
spells.text: Melee spell attack for 3d10 necrotic damage.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Jim's Magic Missile
spells.text: Three darts, each a ranged spell attack for 2d4 force damage. A natural 1 hits you instead; a critical deals 5 extra force damage per dart.
spells.higher: One more dart per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Jump
spells.text: A creature's jump distance is tripled.

spells.name: Longstrider
spells.text: A creature's speed increases by 10 feet.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.text: A willing creature not wearing armor has a base AC of 13 + its Dexterity modifier.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.text: Three darts each hit automatically for 1d4 + 1 force damage.
spells.higher: One more dart per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Magnify Gravity
spells.text: Creatures in a 10-foot-radius sphere make a Constitution save, taking 2d8 force damage and having their speed halved until your next turn (half damage only on success).
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Protection from Evil and Good
spells.text: Aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead have disadvantage on attacks against the target, and can't charm, frighten or possess it. Material: holy water or silver and iron powder, consumed.

spells.name: Purify Food and Drink
spells.text: Purify nonmagical food and drink in a 5-foot-radius sphere of poison and disease.

spells.name: Ray of Sickness
spells.text: Ranged spell attack for 2d8 poison damage; the target makes a Constitution save or is poisoned until your next turn.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.text: A creature targeting the warded creature with an attack or harmful spell makes a Wisdom save or must choose a new target. Ends if the warded creature attacks or casts a harmful spell.

spells.name: Searing Smite
spells.text: Your next melee weapon hit deals an extra 1d6 fire damage and ignites the target, which takes 1d6 fire at the start of each turn until it succeeds on a Constitution save.
spells.higher: Initial damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Shield
spells.text: When hit by an attack or targeted by magic missile, gain +5 AC until your next turn and take no damage from magic missile.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.text: A creature gains +2 AC.

spells.name: Silent Image
spells.text: A visual illusion up to a 15-foot cube that you can move with an action. An Investigation check against your DC reveals it.

spells.name: Silvery Barbs
spells.text: When a creature succeeds on an attack roll, ability check or save, it rerolls and uses the lower roll. Then another creature gets advantage on its next attack, check or save within 1 minute.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.text: Roll 5d8: creatures within 20 feet of a point fall unconscious in ascending order of current HP, until the total runs out. Undead and creatures immune to charm are unaffected.
spells.higher: 2d8 more per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Snare
spells.text: A nearly invisible magical trap in a 5-foot circle. A creature entering it makes a Dexterity save or is hoisted and restrained upside down.

spells.name: Speak with Animals
spells.text: You can understand and verbally communicate with beasts.

spells.name: Tasha's Caustic Brew
spells.text: Each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line makes a Dexterity save or is covered in acid, taking 2d4 acid damage at the start of each turn until it or another creature scrapes it off with an action.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 2d4 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save or falls prone and is incapacitated with laughter, repeating the save each turn and when damaged (with advantage). Intelligence 4 or less is immune.

spells.name: Tenser's Floating Disk
spells.text: A floating disk holds up to 500 pounds and follows you within 20 feet.

spells.name: Thunderous Smite
spells.text: Your next melee weapon hit deals an extra 2d6 thunder damage, and the target makes a Strength save or is pushed 10 feet and knocked prone.

spells.name: Thunderwave
spells.text: Each creature in a 15-foot cube makes a Constitution save, taking 2d8 thunder damage and being pushed 10 feet on a failure, or half on a success.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Unseen Servant
spells.text: An invisible, mindless force performs simple tasks at your command.

spells.name: Witch Bolt
spells.text: Ranged spell attack for 1d12 lightning damage; on later turns use your action to deal 1d12 lightning automatically.
spells.higher: Initial damage increases by 1d12 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Wrathful Smite
spells.text: Your next melee weapon hit deals an extra 1d6 psychic damage, and the target makes a Wisdom save or is frightened of you. It can use an action for a Wisdom check to end it.

spells.name: Zephyr Strike
spells.text: You don't provoke opportunity attacks. Once, you can gain advantage on one weapon attack, which deals an extra 1d8 force damage, and your speed increases by 30 feet until the end of that turn.

spells.name: Aganazzar's Scorcher
spells.text: A 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line of fire. Each creature in it makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d8 fire damage (half on success).
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Aid
spells.text: Up to three creatures increase their hit point maximum and current hit points by 5.
spells.higher: 5 more per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Air Bubble
spells.text: A spectral globe surrounds the head of a willing creature, letting it breathe in airless environments and underwater.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Alter Self
spells.text: Choose a form: aquatic adaptation (gills, swim speed), change appearance, or natural weapons (1d6, magical, +1 to hit and damage). Change form with an action.

spells.name: Animal Messenger
spells.text: A Tiny beast carries a 25-word message to a place and recipient you describe, traveling 50 miles per day (25 if it walks).
spells.higher: Duration increases by 48 hours per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Arcane Lock
spells.text: Magically lock a door, window, gate or container; DC to break or pick it increases by 10. Material: gold dust worth 25 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Augury
spells.text: Get an omen (weal, woe, both or nothing) about a course of action within the next 30 minutes. Material: marked sticks, bones or similar worth 25 gp.

spells.name: Barkskin
spells.text: A willing creature's AC can't be less than 16.

spells.name: Beast Sense
spells.text: See and hear through a willing beast's senses as an action, being blind and deaf to your own surroundings while you do.

spells.name: Blindness/Deafness
spells.text: A creature makes a Constitution save or is blinded or deafened (your choice), repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Blur
spells.text: Attack rolls against you have disadvantage, unless the attacker has blindsight or truesight.

spells.name: Borrowed Knowledge
spells.text: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice. Material: a book worth 25 gp.

spells.name: Branding Smite
spells.text: Your next weapon hit deals an extra 2d6 radiant damage, and an invisible target becomes visible and can't turn invisible.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Calm Emotions
spells.text: Humanoids in a 20-foot-radius sphere make a Charisma save or have charm and fear effects suppressed, or become indifferent toward creatures they are hostile to.

spells.name: Cloud of Daggers
spells.text: Spinning daggers fill a 5-foot cube; a creature entering it or starting its turn there takes 4d4 slashing damage.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 2d4 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Continual Flame
spells.text: A heatless flame as bright as a torch that can't be smothered. Material: ruby dust worth 50 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Cordon of Arrows
spells.text: Plant four pieces of ammunition; when a creature comes within 30 feet for the first time on a turn, one attacks it: Dexterity save or 1d6 piercing damage.
spells.higher: Two more pieces per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Crown of Madness
spells.text: A humanoid makes a Wisdom save or is charmed and must attack a creature you choose before moving each turn. Use your action each turn to maintain it.

spells.name: Darkness
spells.text: Magical darkness fills a 15-foot-radius sphere; darkvision can't see through it and nonmagical light can't illuminate it.

spells.name: Darkvision
spells.text: A willing creature gains darkvision out to 60 feet.

spells.name: Detect Thoughts
spells.text: Read the surface thoughts of a creature within 30 feet, or probe deeper (Wisdom save). You can also sense thinking creatures you can't see.

spells.name: Dragon's Breath
spells.text: A willing creature can use its action to exhale a 15-foot cone of acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison: Dexterity save, 3d6 damage (half on success).
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Dust Devil
spells.text: A 5-foot-cube elemental whirlwind. Creatures ending their turn within 5 feet make a Strength save or take 1d8 bludgeoning damage and are pushed 10 feet. Move it 30 feet as a bonus action.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Earthbind
spells.text: A creature makes a Strength save or its flying speed becomes 0, descending 60 feet per round until it lands.

spells.name: Enhance Ability
spells.text: Grant one benefit: Bear's Endurance (2d6 temp HP, advantage on Con checks), Bull's Strength, Cat's Grace, Eagle's Splendor, Fox's Cunning or Owl's Wisdom (advantage on that ability's checks).
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Enlarge/Reduce
spells.text: A creature or object doubles or halves in size (Constitution save if unwilling). Enlarged: advantage on Strength checks and saves, weapons deal +1d4. Reduced: disadvantage, weapons deal -1d4.

spells.name: Enthrall
spells.text: Creatures that can hear you make a Wisdom save or have disadvantage on Perception checks to notice creatures other than you.

spells.name: Find Steed
spells.text: Summon a loyal, intelligent steed spirit (warhorse, pony, camel, elk or mastiff) that shares your self-targeting spells.

spells.name: Find Traps
spells.text: Sense the presence of any trap in range and line of sight, and its general nature.

spells.name: Flame Blade
spells.text: A fiery blade in your hand: melee spell attacks for 3d6 fire damage. It sheds light 10 feet.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 for every two slot levels above 2.

spells.name: Flaming Sphere
spells.text: A 5-foot sphere of fire; creatures ending their turn within 5 feet make a Dexterity save or take 2d6 fire damage. Move it 30 feet as a bonus action, ramming creatures.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Flock of Familiars
spells.text: Summon three familiars of one type (celestial, fey or fiend) that work like Find Familiar and share telepathy and senses within 1 mile.
spells.higher: One more familiar per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Fortune's Favor
spells.text: Once before the spell ends, a creature can roll an extra d20 for an attack, check or save, or when attacked, and choose which roll to use. Material: a white pearl worth 100 gp, consumed.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Gentle Repose
spells.text: A corpse doesn't decay and can't become undead; the days don't count toward raise dead time limits.

spells.name: Gift of Gab
spells.text: When you speak, the creatures that heard your last 6 seconds of speech remember it as something else you choose. Material: 2 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Gust of Wind
spells.text: A 60-foot-long, 10-foot-wide line of wind. Creatures starting their turn there make a Strength save or are pushed 15 feet; moving against it costs double.

spells.name: Healing Spirit
spells.text: A spirit fills a 5-foot cube; a creature moving into it or starting its turn there regains 1d6 hit points, a number of times equal to 1 + your spellcasting modifier. Move it 30 feet as a bonus action.
spells.higher: Healing increases by 1d6 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Heat Metal
spells.text: A metal object glows red-hot: creatures touching it take 2d8 fire damage and must save or drop it, or have disadvantage on attacks and checks. Repeat the damage as a bonus action.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Hold Person
spells.text: A humanoid makes a Wisdom save or is paralyzed, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.
spells.higher: One additional humanoid per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Immovable Object
spells.text: An object of 10 pounds or less is fixed in place, holding up to 4,000 pounds. You can set a password to move it. Material: gold dust worth 25 gp, consumed.
spells.higher: Level 4-5: 24 hours. Level 6+: permanent.

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.text: A creature becomes invisible until it attacks or casts a spell.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Jim's Glowing Coin
spells.text: A coin you throw glows and makes noise; creatures within 30 feet of it make a Wisdom save or are distracted, having disadvantage on Perception checks and initiative.

spells.name: Kinetic Jaunt
spells.text: Your speed increases by 10 feet, you don't provoke opportunity attacks, and you can move through creatures' spaces.

spells.name: Knock
spells.text: Unlock a locked, stuck or barred object, or suppress arcane lock for 10 minutes. It knocks loudly.

spells.name: Lesser Restoration
spells.text: End one disease or condition: blinded, deafened, paralyzed or poisoned.

spells.name: Levitate
spells.text: A creature or object up to 500 pounds rises up to 20 feet (Constitution save if unwilling); move it up or down 20 feet each turn.

spells.name: Locate Animals or Plants
spells.text: Learn the direction and distance to the closest beast or plant of a kind you name within 5 miles.

spells.name: Locate Object
spells.text: Sense the direction to an object you know or describe within 1,000 feet. Blocked by lead.

spells.name: Magic Mouth
spells.text: An object speaks a message of up to 25 words when a trigger you set occurs. Material: jade dust worth 10 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Magic Weapon
spells.text: A nonmagical weapon gains +1 to attack and damage rolls.
spells.higher: +2 at level 4-5, +3 at level 6+.

spells.name: Maximillian's Earthen Grasp
spells.text: An earthen hand grabs a Medium or smaller creature: Strength save or 2d6 bludgeoning damage and restrained. Crush again with an action.

spells.name: Melf's Acid Arrow
spells.text: Ranged spell attack: 4d4 acid damage plus 2d4 at the end of its next turn; on a miss, half the initial damage.
spells.higher: Both damages increase by 1d4 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Mind Spike
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save, taking 3d8 psychic damage (half on success). On a failure you always know its location on the same plane.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Mirror Image
spells.text: Three illusory duplicates; when attacked, roll a d20 to see if a duplicate is hit instead (6+ with three, 8+ with two, 11+ with one).

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.text: Teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

spells.name: Moonbeam
spells.text: A 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder of moonlight. A creature entering it or starting its turn there makes a Constitution save, taking 2d10 radiant damage (half on success). Move it 60 feet as an action.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Nathair's Mischief
spells.text: A 20-foot cube of fey mischief. Roll each turn for a random effect: charm (Wisdom save), blinding fog (Dexterity save), confusion (incapacitated, Wisdom save) or difficult terrain.

spells.name: Nystul's Magic Aura
spells.text: Change how a creature or object appears to divination: false magic aura on objects, or masked creature type or alignment.

spells.name: Pass without Trace
spells.text: You and allies within 30 feet have +10 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can't be tracked except by magic.

spells.name: Phantasmal Force
spells.text: A creature makes an Intelligence save or sees a phantasm only it perceives (up to a 10-foot cube). A harmful phantasm deals 1d6 psychic damage each turn.

spells.name: Prayer of Healing
spells.text: Up to six creatures regain 2d8 + your spellcasting modifier hit points.
spells.higher: Healing increases by 1d8 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Protection from Poison
spells.text: Neutralize one poison on a creature; it has advantage on saves against being poisoned and resistance to poison damage.

spells.name: Pyrotechnics
spells.text: Turn a nonmagical flame into fireworks (creatures within 10 feet make a Constitution save or are blinded) or a 20-foot-radius cloud of thick smoke for 1 minute.

spells.name: Ray of Enfeeblement
spells.text: Ranged spell attack: on a hit the target deals only half damage with Strength-based weapon attacks, repeating a Constitution save each turn.

spells.name: Rime's Binding Ice
spells.text: Each creature in a 30-foot cone makes a Constitution save, taking 3d8 cold damage and having its speed reduced to 0 for 1 minute on a failure (an action breaks free), or half damage on a success.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Rope Trick
spells.text: A rope rises to an invisible extradimensional space that holds up to eight Medium creatures.

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.text: Three rays, each a ranged spell attack for 2d6 fire damage.
spells.higher: One more ray per slot level above 2.

spells.name: See Invisibility
spells.text: You see invisible creatures and objects and into the Ethereal Plane.

spells.name: Shadow Blade
spells.text: A shadow blade (finesse, light, thrown 20/60) deals 2d8 psychic damage. Attacks have advantage if the target is in dim light or darkness.
spells.higher: 3d8 at level 3-4, 4d8 at 5-6, 5d8 at 7+.

spells.name: Shatter
spells.text: Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere makes a Constitution save, taking 3d8 thunder damage (half on success); inorganic creatures have disadvantage.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Silence
spells.text: No sound in a 20-foot-radius sphere; creatures inside are deafened and immune to thunder damage, and can't cast spells with verbal components.

spells.name: Skywrite
spells.text: Write up to ten words in the sky with clouds.

spells.name: Snilloc's Snowball Swarm
spells.text: Each creature in a 5-foot-radius sphere makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d6 cold damage (half on success).
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Spider Climb
spells.text: A creature can climb surfaces and ceilings with hands free and gains a climbing speed equal to its walking speed.

spells.name: Spike Growth
spells.text: A 20-foot-radius area becomes difficult terrain with hidden spikes: 2d4 piercing damage for every 5 feet moved. A Perception check against your DC spots it.

spells.name: Spiritual Weapon
spells.text: A floating spectral weapon. When cast and as a bonus action later, move it 20 feet and make a melee spell attack for 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier force damage.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 for every two slot levels above 2.

spells.name: Spray of Cards
spells.text: Each creature in a 15-foot cone makes a Dexterity save: on a failure 2d10 force damage and blinded until the end of its next turn; half damage only on a success.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Suggestion
spells.text: Suggest a reasonable course of activity to a creature; on a failed Wisdom save it pursues it.

spells.name: Summon Beast
spells.text: Summon a Bestial Spirit (air, land or water) that obeys you. Its stats scale with the spell's level. Material: a feather, fur or fish tail in a gilded acorn worth 200 gp.
spells.higher: Uses the higher slot level in its stat block.

spells.name: Tasha's Mind Whip
spells.text: A creature makes an Intelligence save, taking 3d6 psychic damage and losing its reaction, and on its next turn it can only move, act or use a bonus action (one of them). Half damage only on a success.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Vortex Warp
spells.text: Teleport a creature you can see to an unoccupied space you can see within range (Constitution save to resist if unwilling).
spells.higher: Range increases by 30 feet per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Warding Bond
spells.text: A willing creature gets +1 AC and saves and resistance to all damage, and you take the same damage it does. Material: platinum rings worth 50 gp each.

spells.name: Warding Wind
spells.text: A strong wind in a 10-foot radius around you: deafens creatures inside, disperses gas, makes the area difficult terrain for others and gives disadvantage to ranged weapon attacks through it.

spells.name: Warp Sense
spells.text: Sense portals within 30 feet. With an action and a DC 15 spellcasting check you learn a portal's destination and key.

spells.name: Web
spells.text: Webs fill a 20-foot cube: difficult terrain and lightly obscured. Creatures there make a Dexterity save or are restrained, escaping with a Strength check.

spells.name: Wither and Bloom
spells.text: Creatures you choose in a 10-foot-radius sphere make a Constitution save, taking 2d6 necrotic damage (half on success). One creature in the area can spend a Hit Die to heal.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 and one more Hit Die can be spent per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Wristpocket
spells.text: Send an object of 5 pounds or less you are holding into an extradimensional space; retrieve it with a bonus action, ending the spell.

spells.name: Zone of Truth
spells.text: Creatures in a 15-foot-radius sphere make a Charisma save; those that fail can't speak a deliberate lie.

spells.name: Animate Dead
spells.text: Raise a skeleton or zombie from bones or a corpse, under your control for 24 hours. Command any within 60 feet as a bonus action. Recast to keep control of up to four.
spells.higher: Two more undead per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Antagonize
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save: on a failure 4d4 psychic damage and it must use its reaction to attack a creature you choose (or has disadvantage on its next attack). Half damage only on a success.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d4 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Ashardalon's Stride
spells.text: Your speed increases by 20 feet and you don't provoke opportunity attacks; each creature you move within 5 feet of takes 1d6 fire damage (once per turn).
spells.higher: Speed increases by 5 feet and damage by 1d6 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Aura of Vitality
spells.text: As a bonus action each turn, a creature in a 30-foot aura regains 2d6 hit points.

spells.name: Beacon of Hope
spells.text: Any number of creatures have advantage on Wisdom saves and death saves and regain the maximum possible hit points from healing.

spells.name: Bestow Curse
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save or is cursed: disadvantage on checks and saves of one ability, disadvantage on attacks against you, a save each turn or lose its action, or your attacks deal it 1d8 extra necrotic.
spells.higher: Level 4: 10 minutes. Level 5: 8 hours. Level 7: 24 hours. Level 9: until dispelled; no concentration from level 5.

spells.name: Blinding Smite
spells.text: Your next melee weapon hit deals an extra 3d8 radiant damage, and the target makes a Constitution save or is blinded, repeating the save each turn.

spells.name: Blink
spells.text: At the end of each of your turns, roll a d20: on 11+ you vanish to the Ethereal Plane until your next turn.

spells.name: Call Lightning
spells.text: A storm cloud forms; as an action call a bolt: creatures within 5 feet of the point make a Dexterity save, taking 3d10 lightning damage (half on success), 4d10 if already stormy.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Catnap
spells.text: Up to three willing creatures fall unconscious; one that sleeps 10 minutes gains the benefit of a short rest.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Clairvoyance
spells.text: Create an invisible sensor at a familiar or obvious location to see or hear through. Material: a focus worth 100 gp.

spells.name: Conjure Animals
spells.text: Summon fey spirits as beasts: one of CR 2, two of CR 1, four of CR 1/2 or eight of CR 1/4. They obey your commands.
spells.higher: Level 5: twice as many. Level 7: three times. Level 9: four times.

spells.name: Conjure Barrage
spells.text: Throw or fire a weapon to create copies: each creature in a 60-foot cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d8 damage of the weapon's type (half on success).

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.text: Interrupt a creature casting a spell: a spell of 3rd level or lower fails; for higher levels make a spellcasting ability check, DC 10 + its level.
spells.higher: Automatically stops spells of the slot's level or lower.

spells.name: Create Food and Water
spells.text: Create 45 pounds of food and 30 gallons of water, enough for fifteen humanoids or five steeds for 24 hours.

spells.name: Crusader's Mantle
spells.text: Allies within 30 feet (and you) deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage with weapon hits.

spells.name: Daylight
spells.text: A 60-foot-radius sphere of bright light. Dispels magical darkness of 3rd level or lower.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
spells.text: End spells of 3rd level or lower on a target; for higher levels, make a spellcasting check, DC 10 + its level.
spells.higher: Automatically ends spells of the slot's level or lower.

spells.name: Elemental Weapon
spells.text: A nonmagical weapon gains +1 to attack and an extra 1d4 acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage.
spells.higher: Level 5-6: +2 and 2d4. Level 7+: +3 and 3d4.

spells.name: Enemies Abound
spells.text: A creature makes an Intelligence save or loses the ability to tell friend from foe, choosing targets at random among creatures it can see.

spells.name: Erupting Earth
spells.text: A 20-foot cube of ground erupts: each creature makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d12 bludgeoning damage (half on success); the area becomes difficult terrain.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d12 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Fast Friends
spells.text: A humanoid makes a Wisdom save or is charmed and performs services or activities you ask, as long as they aren't harmful to it.
spells.higher: Level 4: one more creature per slot level.

spells.name: Fear
spells.text: Each creature in a 30-foot cone makes a Wisdom save or drops what it holds and is frightened, dashing away from you.

spells.name: Feign Death
spells.text: A willing creature appears dead: blinded and incapacitated, speed 0, resistance to all damage but psychic.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.text: A 20-foot-radius sphere explodes: each creature makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d6 fire damage (half on success).
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Flame Arrows
spells.text: Up to twelve pieces of ammunition from a quiver deal an extra 1d6 fire damage on a hit.
spells.higher: Two more pieces per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Fly
spells.text: A willing creature gains a flying speed of 60 feet.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Galder's Tower
spells.text: Create a two-story tower with themed, furnished rooms. Cast daily in the same spot for a year to make it permanent.
spells.higher: One more story per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Gaseous Form
spells.text: A willing creature becomes a misty cloud: fly speed 10 feet, resistance to nonmagical damage, advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saves.

spells.name: Glyph of Warding
spells.text: A glyph triggers on conditions you set: Explosive Runes (20-foot sphere, Dexterity save, 5d8 damage) or Spell Glyph (stores a spell of 3rd level or lower). Material: diamond dust worth 200 gp, consumed.
spells.higher: Runes deal 1d8 more and the glyph can store higher spells per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Haste
spells.text: A willing creature's speed doubles, +2 AC, advantage on Dexterity saves and an extra action (one attack, Dash, Disengage, Hide or Use an Object). Lethargy for a turn when it ends.

spells.name: Hunger of Hadar
spells.text: A 20-foot-radius sphere of blackness and cold, difficult terrain. Creatures starting their turn there take 2d6 cold damage; ending it there, Dexterity save or 2d6 acid.

spells.name: Hypnotic Pattern
spells.text: Creatures in a 30-foot cube that see the pattern make a Wisdom save or are charmed and incapacitated with speed 0, until damaged or shaken awake.

spells.name: Incite Greed
spells.text: Show a gem worth 50+ gp: creatures that see it make a Wisdom save or are charmed and can only move toward you, repeating the save each turn.

spells.name: Intellect Fortress
spells.text: A willing creature has resistance to psychic damage and advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Leomund's Tiny Hut
spells.text: A 10-foot dome holds up to nine creatures; spells and creatures can't pass in from outside. Ends if you leave.

spells.name: Life Transference
spells.text: You take 4d8 necrotic damage (can't be reduced) and a creature regains twice that many hit points.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Lightning Arrow
spells.text: Your next ranged weapon attack becomes lightning: 4d8 lightning on a hit (half on a miss), and creatures within 10 feet make a Dexterity save or take 2d8.
spells.higher: Both damages increase by 1d8 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.text: A 100-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line: each creature makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d6 lightning damage (half on success).
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Magic Circle
spells.text: A 10-foot-radius cylinder against celestials, elementals, fey, fiends or undead: they can't enter willingly, have disadvantage on attacks against those inside and can't charm, frighten or possess them. Can be reversed to trap. Material: silver and iron powder worth 100 gp, consumed.
spells.higher: Duration increases by 1 hour per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Major Image
spells.text: An illusion up to a 20-foot cube with sound, smell and temperature.
spells.higher: Level 6+: lasts until dispelled, no concentration.

spells.name: Mass Healing Word
spells.text: Up to six creatures regain 1d4 + your spellcasting modifier hit points.
spells.higher: Healing increases by 1d4 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Meld into Stone
spells.text: Step into a stone object or surface large enough to hold you.

spells.name: Melf's Minute Meteors
spells.text: Six tiny meteors orbit you. As a bonus action send one or two to points within 120 feet: creatures within 5 feet make a Dexterity save, taking 2d6 fire damage (half on success).
spells.higher: Two more meteors per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Motivational Speech
spells.text: Up to five creatures gain 5 temporary hit points and advantage on Wisdom saves; when one is hit, it has advantage on its next attack.
spells.higher: Temporary hit points increase by 5 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Nondetection
spells.text: A creature, place or object can't be targeted by divination magic or perceived through scrying sensors. Material: diamond dust worth 25 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Phantom Steed
spells.text: A quasi-real horse with speed 100 feet for a rider you designate.

spells.name: Plant Growth
spells.text: Overgrowth in a 100-foot radius (each foot of movement costs 4) or enrichment in a half-mile radius (double harvest for a year).

spells.name: Protection from Energy
spells.text: A willing creature has resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder (choose one).

spells.name: Pulse Wave
spells.text: Each creature in a 30-foot cone makes a Constitution save, taking 6d6 force damage and being pulled or pushed up to 15 feet (half damage only on success).
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 and distance by 5 feet per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Remove Curse
spells.text: All curses on a creature or object end; cursed items let the owner remove them.

spells.name: Revivify
spells.text: A creature that died within the last minute returns to life with 1 hit point. Material: diamonds worth 300 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Sending
spells.text: Send a 25-word message to a familiar creature anywhere; it can reply. 5% failure across planes.

spells.name: Sleet Storm
spells.text: A 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder of sleet: heavily obscured, difficult terrain. Creatures entering or starting there make a Dexterity save or fall prone; concentration requires a save.

spells.name: Slow
spells.text: Up to six creatures in a 40-foot cube make a Wisdom save or have speed halved, -2 AC and Dexterity saves, no reactions, one action or bonus action, and one attack. Repeat the save each turn.

spells.name: Speak with Dead
spells.text: A corpse answers up to five questions with what it knew in life.

spells.name: Speak with Plants
spells.text: Plants within 30 feet communicate and can follow simple commands, and you can make plant difficult terrain normal or vice versa.

spells.name: Spirit Guardians
spells.text: Spirits in a 15-foot radius halve enemies' speed. An enemy entering or starting its turn there makes a Wisdom save, taking 3d8 radiant (or necrotic) damage, half on success.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Spirit Shroud
spells.text: Your attacks against creatures within 10 feet deal an extra 1d8 radiant, necrotic or cold damage and stop healing; enemies starting their turn within 10 feet have speed reduced by 10 feet.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 for every two slot levels above 3.

spells.name: Stinking Cloud
spells.text: A 20-foot-radius sphere of gas: heavily obscured; creatures starting their turn there make a Constitution save or lose their action retching.

spells.name: Summon Fey
spells.text: Summon a Fey Spirit (fuming, mirthful or tricksy) that obeys you. Its stats scale with the spell's level. Material: a gilded flower worth 300 gp.
spells.higher: Uses the higher slot level in its stat block.

spells.name: Summon Lesser Demons
spells.text: Roll for random demons (CR 1 or lower) that are hostile to all creatures, including you. A blood circle protects you from them.
spells.higher: Level 6-7: twice as many. Level 8-9: three times.

spells.name: Summon Shadowspawn
spells.text: Summon a Shadow Spirit (fury, despair or fear) that obeys you. Its stats scale with the spell's level. Material: tears inside a gem worth 300 gp.
spells.higher: Uses the higher slot level in its stat block.

spells.name: Summon Undead
spells.text: Summon an Undead Spirit (ghostly, putrid or skeletal) that obeys you. Its stats scale with the spell's level. Material: a gilded skull worth 300 gp.
spells.higher: Uses the higher slot level in its stat block.

spells.name: Thunder Step
spells.text: Teleport up to 90 feet (optionally with a willing creature); creatures within 10 feet of where you left make a Constitution save, taking 3d10 thunder damage (half on success).
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Tidal Wave
spells.text: A wave in a 30-by-10-by-10-foot area: Dexterity save, 4d8 bludgeoning damage and prone (half on success). Extinguishes flames.

spells.name: Tiny Servant
spells.text: A Tiny object becomes a creature that obeys your commands (bonus action), with attacks of its own.
spells.higher: Two more objects per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Tongues
spells.text: A creature understands any spoken language and is understood by any creature that knows a language.

spells.name: Vampiric Touch
spells.text: Melee spell attack for 3d6 necrotic damage, healing you for half; repeat as an action each turn.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Wall of Sand
spells.text: A wall of swirling sand 30 feet long, 10 high and 10 thick; it blocks sight, blinds those inside and costs triple movement.

spells.name: Wall of Water
spells.text: A wall of water 30 feet long, 10 high and 1 thick (or a ring). Difficult terrain, disadvantage on ranged attacks through it, and fire damage through it is halved.

spells.name: Water Breathing
spells.text: Up to ten willing creatures can breathe underwater.

spells.name: Water Walk
spells.text: Up to ten willing creatures can move across liquid surfaces as if solid ground.

spells.name: Wind Wall
spells.text: A wall of wind 50 feet long, 15 high and 1 thick: creatures in it when it appears make a Strength save, 3d8 bludgeoning (half on success). It blocks gas, small fliers and arrows.

spells.name: Arcane Eye
spells.text: An invisible floating eye with darkvision 30 feet that you see through; move it 30 feet as an action.

spells.name: Aura of Life
spells.text: Allies within 30 feet have resistance to necrotic damage and their hit point maximum can't be reduced; a living ally at 0 HP that starts its turn there regains 1 HP.

spells.name: Aura of Purity
spells.text: Allies within 30 feet can't become diseased, have resistance to poison damage and advantage on saves against blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned and stunned.

spells.name: Banishment
spells.text: A creature makes a Charisma save or is banished to a harmless demiplane (or its home plane if it's from elsewhere and the spell lasts 1 minute).
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Blight
spells.text: A creature makes a Constitution save, taking 8d8 necrotic damage (half on success). Plants have disadvantage and take maximum damage.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Charm Monster
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save (advantage if fighting you) or is charmed by you.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Compulsion
spells.text: Creatures that fail a Wisdom save must move in a direction you choose with a bonus action on their turns.

spells.name: Confusion
spells.text: Creatures in a 10-foot-radius sphere make a Wisdom save or act randomly each turn (d10), repeating the save at the end of their turns.
spells.higher: Radius increases by 5 feet per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Conjure Minor Elementals
spells.text: Summon elementals: one of CR 2, two of CR 1, four of CR 1/2 or eight of CR 1/4. They obey you.
spells.higher: Level 6: twice as many. Level 8: three times.

spells.name: Conjure Woodland Beings
spells.text: Summon fey: one of CR 2, two of CR 1, four of CR 1/2 or eight of CR 1/4. They obey you.
spells.higher: Level 6: twice as many. Level 8: three times.

spells.name: Control Water
spells.text: Control water in a 100-foot cube: flood, part water, redirect flow or create a whirlpool.

spells.name: Death Ward
spells.text: The first time the target would drop to 0 hit points, it drops to 1 instead; also negates one instant-death effect.

spells.name: Dimension Door
spells.text: Teleport up to 500 feet, optionally with one willing creature. An occupied destination deals 4d6 force damage and the teleport fails.

spells.name: Divination
spells.text: Ask one question about an event within 7 days and get a truthful reply. Material: incense and an offering worth 25 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Dominate Beast
spells.text: A beast makes a Wisdom save or is charmed and follows your telepathic commands; it repeats the save when damaged.
spells.higher: Level 5: 10 minutes. Level 6: 1 hour. Level 7+: 8 hours.

spells.name: Elemental Bane
spells.text: A creature makes a Constitution save or loses resistance to a damage type you choose and takes an extra 2d6 of that type the first time each turn it takes it.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Evard's Black Tentacles
spells.text: A 20-foot square of tentacles, difficult terrain. A creature entering or starting its turn there makes a Dexterity save or takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage and is restrained.

spells.name: Fabricate
spells.text: Turn raw materials into products: up to a Large object (or 10-foot cube), or Medium for minerals. Fine work needs artisan's tools proficiency.

spells.name: Find Greater Steed
spells.text: Summon a loyal, intelligent greater steed spirit: griffon, pegasus, peryton, dire wolf, rhinoceros or saber-toothed tiger.

spells.name: Fire Shield
spells.text: Warm shield (resistance to cold) or chill shield (resistance to fire); melee attackers within 5 feet take 2d8 fire or cold damage.

spells.name: Freedom of Movement
spells.text: A creature ignores difficult terrain, can't be paralyzed or restrained by magic, can escape grapples with 5 feet of movement and moves freely underwater.

spells.name: Galder's Speedy Courier
spells.text: An air elemental with a chest carries items to a creature you have met; it can take them out before the spell ends. Material: 25 gp, consumed.
spells.higher: With a level 8 slot it can reach another plane.

spells.name: Gate Seal
spells.text: Portals in a 30-foot cube close and can't open, and planar travel into or out of it fails. Material: a broken portal key, consumed.
spells.higher: Level 6+: lasts until dispelled.

spells.name: Giant Insect
spells.text: Turn up to ten centipedes, three spiders, five wasps or one scorpion into giant versions that obey you.

spells.name: Grasping Vine
spells.text: A vine sprouts; as a bonus action it lashes at a creature within 30 feet: Dexterity save or pulled 20 feet toward it.

spells.name: Gravity Sinkhole
spells.text: A 20-foot-radius sphere of crushing gravity: Constitution save, 5d10 force damage and pulled toward the center (half damage only on success).
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Greater Invisibility
spells.text: A creature becomes invisible, even while attacking or casting.

spells.name: Guardian of Faith
spells.text: A spectral guardian; a hostile creature that moves within 10 feet of it for the first time on a turn makes a Dexterity save, taking 20 radiant damage (half on success). It vanishes after 60 damage.

spells.name: Guardian of Nature
spells.text: Primal Beast (speed +10, darkvision, advantage on Strength attacks, +1d6 force on melee hits) or Great Tree (10 temp HP, advantage on Constitution saves and Dexterity and Wisdom attacks, difficult terrain for enemies within 15 feet).

spells.name: Hallucinatory Terrain
spells.text: Natural terrain in a 150-foot cube looks, sounds and smells like another kind.

spells.name: Ice Storm
spells.text: A 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder of hail: Dexterity save, 2d8 bludgeoning and 4d6 cold damage (half on success). Difficult terrain until your next turn.
spells.higher: Bludgeoning damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Leomund's Secret Chest
spells.text: Hide a chest on the Ethereal Plane and recall it with its replica. Material: a chest worth 5,000 gp and a replica worth 50 gp.

spells.name: Locate Creature
spells.text: Sense the direction to a creature you know or describe within 1,000 feet. Running water blocks it.

spells.name: Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound
spells.text: An invisible watchdog barks at intruders and bites (melee spell attack, 4d8 piercing) hostile creatures within 5 feet.

spells.name: Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum
spells.text: Secure an area up to a 100-foot cube against sound, sight, divination, teleportation and planar travel.
spells.higher: The area can be 100 feet larger per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Otiluke's Resilient Sphere
spells.text: A sphere of force encloses a Large or smaller creature or object (Dexterity save); nothing passes through it.

spells.name: Phantasmal Killer
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save or is frightened; at the end of each turn it repeats the save or takes 4d10 psychic damage.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Polymorph
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save or turns into a beast of CR up to its level or CR, using its hit points; it reverts when they drop to 0.

spells.name: Raulothim's Psychic Lance
spells.text: A creature (or one you name, even unseen) makes an Intelligence save, taking 7d6 psychic damage and incapacitated until your next turn (half damage only on success).
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Shadow of Moil
spells.text: Shadows give you heavy obscurement in dim light, resistance to radiant damage, and a creature that hits you within 10 feet takes 2d8 necrotic damage.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Sickening Radiance
spells.text: A 30-foot-radius sphere of dim green light: a creature entering or starting its turn there makes a Constitution save or takes 4d10 radiant damage, gains a level of exhaustion and glows.

spells.name: Spirit of Death
spells.text: Summon a Reaper Spirit that obeys you and frightens creatures nearby. Its stats scale with the spell's level. Material: a diamond worth 400 gp.
spells.higher: Uses the higher slot level in its stat block.

spells.name: Staggering Smite
spells.text: Your next melee weapon hit deals an extra 4d6 psychic damage; the target makes a Wisdom save or has disadvantage on attacks and checks and can't take reactions until its next turn.

spells.name: Stone Shape
spells.text: Reshape a Medium or smaller stone object (or 5-foot section) into any form.

spells.name: Stoneskin
spells.text: A willing creature has resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage. Material: diamond dust worth 100 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Storm Sphere
spells.text: A 20-foot-radius sphere of wind: difficult terrain; creatures ending a turn there make a Strength save or take 2d6 bludgeoning. As a bonus action shoot lightning from it (ranged spell attack, 4d6, advantage if the target is inside).
spells.higher: Both damages increase by 1d6 per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Summon Aberration
spells.text: Summon an Aberrant Spirit (beholderkin, slaad or star spawn) that obeys you. Its stats scale with the spell's level. Material: a pickled tentacle and eyeball worth 400 gp.
spells.higher: Uses the higher slot level in its stat block.

spells.name: Summon Construct
spells.text: Summon a Construct Spirit (clay, metal or stone) that obeys you. Its stats scale with the spell's level. Material: an ornate stone and metal lockbox worth 400 gp.
spells.higher: Uses the higher slot level in its stat block.

spells.name: Summon Elemental
spells.text: Summon an Elemental Spirit (air, earth, fire or water) that obeys you. Its stats scale with the spell's level. Material: air, a pebble, ash and water in a gold vial worth 400 gp.
spells.higher: Uses the higher slot level in its stat block.

spells.name: Summon Greater Demon
spells.text: Summon a demon of CR 5 or lower that obeys you, but it makes a Charisma save each turn to break free and turn on you. A blood circle protects you.
spells.higher: CR increases by 1 per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Vitriolic Sphere
spells.text: A 20-foot-radius sphere of acid: Dexterity save, 10d4 acid damage plus 5d4 at the end of its next turn (half the initial damage only on success).
spells.higher: Initial damage increases by 2d4 per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Wall of Fire
spells.text: A wall of fire 60 feet long, 20 high and 1 thick (or a ring). Creatures in it make a Dexterity save, 5d8 fire damage (half on success); one side deals 5d8 to creatures ending their turn within 10 feet.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Watery Sphere
spells.text: A 5-foot-radius sphere of water holds up to four Medium creatures (Strength save), restraining them; move it 30 feet as an action.

spells.name: Animate Objects
spells.text: Animate up to ten nonmagical Tiny objects (Small counts as one, Medium two, Large four, Huge eight) that obey your bonus action commands and slam foes.
spells.higher: Two more objects per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Antilife Shell
spells.text: A 10-foot barrier that creatures other than undead and constructs can't pass or reach through.

spells.name: Awaken
spells.text: A beast or plant gains Intelligence 10 and speech, and is charmed by you for 30 days. Material: an agate worth 1,000 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Banishing Smite
spells.text: Your next weapon hit deals an extra 5d10 force damage; if the target drops to 50 HP or fewer, it is banished (to its home plane if from elsewhere).

spells.name: Bigby's Hand
spells.text: A Large force hand you move as a bonus action: clenched fist (4d8 force), forceful hand (push), grasping hand (grapple, 2d6 + modifier crush) or interposing hand (cover).
spells.higher: Fist damage increases by 2d8 and grasp by 2d6 per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Circle of Power
spells.text: Allies within 30 feet have advantage on saves against spells and magical effects; a success on a half-damage save means no damage.

spells.name: Cloudkill
spells.text: A 20-foot-radius sphere of poison fog that moves 10 feet away each turn: Constitution save, 5d8 poison damage (half on success).
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Commune
spells.text: Ask your deity up to three yes-or-no questions.

spells.name: Commune with Nature
spells.text: Learn up to three facts about the land within 3 miles (300 feet underground).

spells.name: Cone of Cold
spells.text: Each creature in a 60-foot cone makes a Constitution save, taking 8d8 cold damage (half on success).
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Conjure Elemental
spells.text: Summon an elemental of CR 5 or lower from a matching source of its element. If you lose concentration it turns hostile.
spells.higher: CR increases by 1 per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Conjure Volley
spells.text: Each creature in a 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d8 damage of your ammunition's type (half on success).

spells.name: Contact Other Plane
spells.text: Ask an extraplanar entity five questions after a DC 15 Intelligence save; failing deals 6d6 psychic damage and madness.

spells.name: Contagion
spells.text: Melee spell attack: the target is poisoned and must save each turn; three failures give it a disease of your choice for 7 days.

spells.name: Control Winds
spells.text: Control air in a 100-foot cube: gusts, downdraft or updraft, each with its own effect.

spells.name: Create Spelljamming Helm
spells.text: Turn a chair into a spelljamming helm that lets a ship move through space. Material: a crystal rod worth 5,000 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Creation
spells.text: Create a nonliving object up to a 5-foot cube; its duration depends on the material.
spells.higher: The cube grows by 5 feet per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Danse Macabre
spells.text: Up to five Small or Medium corpses become zombies or skeletons that obey you and add your spellcasting modifier to attacks and damage.
spells.higher: Two more corpses per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Dawn
spells.text: A 30-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder of sunlight: Constitution save, 4d10 radiant damage (half on success) when it appears and at the end of each of your turns. Move it 60 feet as a bonus action.

spells.name: Destructive Wave
spells.text: Creatures you choose within 30 feet make a Constitution save, taking 5d6 thunder and 5d6 radiant or necrotic damage and falling prone (half and not prone on success).

spells.name: Dispel Evil and Good
spells.text: Celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead have disadvantage against you; you can end the spell to break their charm or possession, or banish one with a touch.

spells.name: Dominate Person
spells.text: A humanoid makes a Wisdom save or is charmed and follows your telepathic commands; it repeats the save when damaged.
spells.higher: Level 6: 10 minutes. Level 7: 1 hour. Level 8+: 8 hours.

spells.name: Dream
spells.text: Shape the dreams of a creature you know: speak with it, or make it a nightmare (Wisdom save or no rest and 3d6 psychic damage).

spells.name: Enervation
spells.text: A tendril drains a creature: Dexterity save, 4d8 necrotic damage (2d8 on success, ending the spell); you heal half. Repeat as an action each turn.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Far Step
spells.text: Teleport up to 60 feet, and again as a bonus action on each turn before the spell ends.

spells.name: Flame Strike
spells.text: A 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder of fire: Dexterity save, 4d6 fire and 4d6 radiant damage (half on success).
spells.higher: Fire or radiant damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Geas
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save or must follow a command, taking 5d10 psychic damage once a day when it acts against it.
spells.higher: Level 7-8: 1 year. Level 9: until ended.

spells.name: Greater Restoration
spells.text: Remove a level of exhaustion, charm or petrification, a curse, an ability score reduction or a hit point maximum reduction. Material: diamond dust worth 100 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Hallow
spells.text: Consecrate a 60-foot-radius area against celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead, plus an extra effect. Material: herbs, oils and incense worth 1,000 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Hold Monster
spells.text: A creature (not undead) makes a Wisdom save or is paralyzed, repeating the save each turn.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Holy Weapon
spells.text: A weapon deals an extra 2d8 radiant damage on a hit and sheds light. As a bonus action end it to blind creatures within 30 feet (Constitution save) and deal 4d8 radiant.

spells.name: Immolation
spells.text: A creature makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d6 fire damage (half on success) and burning for 4d6 each turn until it succeeds on a save.
