spells.name: Infernal Calling
spells.text: Summon a devil of CR 6 or lower. It isn't controlled; you can command it if you know its true name.
spells.higher: CR increases by 1 per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Insect Plague
spells.text: A 20-foot-radius sphere of locusts: lightly obscured, difficult terrain; Constitution save, 4d10 piercing damage (half on success).
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Legend Lore
spells.text: Learn significant lore about a famous person, place or object. Material: incense worth 250 gp (consumed) and ivory strips worth 50 gp each.

spells.name: Maelstrom
spells.text: A 30-foot-radius whirlpool: difficult terrain; creatures starting their turn there make a Strength save or take 6d6 bludgeoning damage and are pulled 10 feet toward the center.

spells.name: Mass Cure Wounds
spells.text: Up to six creatures in a 30-foot-radius sphere regain 3d8 + your spellcasting modifier hit points.
spells.higher: Healing increases by 1d8 per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Mislead
spells.text: You become invisible and an illusory double appears that you control and can see and hear through.

spells.name: Modify Memory
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save or you rewrite its memory of an event from the last 24 hours.
spells.higher: Level 6: 7 days. Level 7: 30 days. Level 8: 1 year. Level 9: any time.

spells.name: Negative Energy Flood
spells.text: A creature makes a Constitution save, taking 5d12 necrotic damage (half on success); a creature killed rises as a zombie. Undead gain half the roll as temporary HP instead.

spells.name: Passwall
spells.text: A passage up to 5 feet wide, 8 high and 20 deep opens through wood, plaster or stone.

spells.name: Planar Binding
spells.text: A celestial, elemental, fey or fiend makes a Charisma save or must serve you. Material: a jewel worth 1,000 gp, consumed.
spells.higher: Level 6: 10 days. Level 7: 30 days. Level 8: 180 days. Level 9: a year and a day.

spells.name: Raise Dead
spells.text: A creature dead up to 10 days returns with 1 hit point and a -4 penalty that fades with long rests. Material: a diamond worth 500 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Rary's Telepathic Bond
spells.text: Up to eight willing creatures share a telepathic link on the same plane.

spells.name: Reincarnate
spells.text: A creature dead up to 10 days returns in a new body of a random race. Material: oils worth 1,000 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Scrying
spells.text: See and hear a creature on the same plane (Wisdom save modified by your knowledge of it). Material: a focus worth 1,000 gp.

spells.name: Seeming
spells.text: Change the appearance of any number of creatures you can see (Charisma save if unwilling).

spells.name: Skill Empowerment
spells.text: A willing creature doubles its proficiency bonus for one skill it is proficient in.

spells.name: Steel Wind Strike
spells.text: Melee spell attack against up to five creatures, 6d10 force damage each; then teleport next to one of them.

spells.name: Summon Celestial
spells.text: Summon a Celestial Spirit (avenger or defender) that obeys you. Its stats scale with the spell's level. Material: a golden reliquary worth 500 gp.
spells.higher: Uses the higher slot level in its stat block.

spells.name: Summon Draconic Spirit
spells.text: Summon a Draconic Spirit (chromatic, metallic or gem) that obeys you, with a breath weapon and resistances you share. Material: an object with a dragon image worth 500 gp.
spells.higher: Uses the higher slot level in its stat block.

spells.name: Swift Quiver
spells.text: Your quiver creates endless ammunition, and you can make two ranged weapon attacks as a bonus action each turn.

spells.name: Synaptic Static
spells.text: Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere makes an Intelligence save, taking 8d6 psychic damage (half on success); on a failure it subtracts 1d6 from attacks, checks and concentration saves for 1 minute.

spells.name: Telekinesis
spells.text: Move a Huge or smaller creature (contested check) or an object up to 1,000 pounds 30 feet each turn as an action.

spells.name: Teleportation Circle
spells.text: Open a portal to a permanent teleportation circle whose sigil sequence you know. Material: rare chalks and inks worth 50 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Temporal Shunt
spells.text: When a creature attacks or casts a spell, it makes a Wisdom save or vanishes until the start of its next turn, wasting the attack or spell.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Transmute Rock
spells.text: Turn a 40-foot cube of rock into mud (difficult terrain, restrains) or mud into rock (traps creatures).

spells.name: Tree Stride
spells.text: Step into a tree and out of another of the same kind within 500 feet, once per turn.

spells.name: Wall of Force
spells.text: An invisible, indestructible wall (or dome) of force that nothing physical passes through.

spells.name: Wall of Light
spells.text: A wall of light 60 feet long, 10 high and 5 thick: Constitution save, 4d8 radiant damage and blinded (half on success). Shoot a ray from it as an action (4d8 radiant).
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Wall of Stone
spells.text: A stone wall of ten 10-by-10-foot panels, 6 inches thick. Permanent if concentration lasts the full duration.

spells.name: Wrath of Nature
spells.text: Nature in a 60-foot cube turns hostile: grasping undergrowth, trees that lash (4d6 slashing), roots and vines (restrain) and flying rocks (3d8 bludgeoning, prone).

spells.name: Arcane Gate
spells.text: Two linked 10-foot portals; anything entering one exits the other.

spells.name: Blade Barrier
spells.text: A wall of blades 100 feet long (or a ring): three-quarters cover; a creature entering or starting its turn there makes a Dexterity save, taking 6d10 slashing damage (half on success).

spells.name: Bones of the Earth
spells.text: Up to six 5-foot-wide, 30-foot-tall stone pillars erupt; creatures on them are lifted (Dexterity save) and may be crushed against ceilings for 6d6 bludgeoning.
spells.higher: Two more pillars per slot level above 6.

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.text: A bolt hits a target and up to three others within 30 feet: Dexterity save, 10d8 lightning damage (half on success).
spells.higher: One more bolt per slot level above 6.

spells.name: Circle of Death
spells.text: Each creature in a 60-foot-radius sphere makes a Constitution save, taking 8d6 necrotic damage (half on success). Material: black pearl powder worth 500 gp.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 2d6 per slot level above 6.

spells.name: Conjure Fey
spells.text: Summon a fey of CR 6 or lower that obeys you; it turns hostile if you lose concentration.
spells.higher: CR increases by 1 per slot level above 6.

spells.name: Contingency
spells.text: Store a spell of 5th level or lower that targets you, to trigger on a condition you describe. Material: a statuette of you worth 1,500 gp.

spells.name: Create Homunculus
spells.text: Create a homunculus bound to you; you take 2d4 piercing damage and your maximum HP drops by that while it lives. Material: a jewel worth 1,000 gp.

spells.name: Create Undead
spells.text: At night, raise up to three ghouls under your control for 24 hours. Material: a black onyx worth 150 gp per corpse.
spells.higher: Level 7: four ghouls. Level 8: five ghouls or two ghasts or wights. Level 9: six ghouls, three ghasts or wights, or two mummies.

spells.name: Disintegrate
spells.text: A creature makes a Dexterity save or takes 10d6 + 40 force damage; at 0 HP it turns to dust. Destroys force walls and objects.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 3d6 per slot level above 6.

spells.name: Drawmij's Instant Summons
spells.text: Mark an object; crushing the sapphire summons it to your hand from anywhere on the plane. Material: a sapphire worth 1,000 gp.

spells.name: Druid Grove
spells.text: Protect an area up to a 90-foot cube with natural guardians: fog, grasping undergrowth, animated trees, and more. Material: mistletoe and gems worth 10 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Eyebite
spells.text: Each turn, as an action, a creature within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save or is put to sleep, panicked or sickened.

spells.name: Find the Path
spells.text: Know the most direct route to a location you name. Material: divination tools worth 100 gp.

spells.name: Fizban's Platinum Shield
spells.text: A creature gains half cover, resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning and poison, and evasion. Move the shield to another creature as a bonus action. Material: platinum-plated dragon scale worth 500 gp.

spells.name: Flesh to Stone
spells.text: A creature makes a Constitution save or is restrained; three failures petrify it, three successes end it.

spells.name: Forbiddance
spells.text: Ward up to 40,000 square feet against teleportation and planar travel; chosen creature types take 5d10 radiant or necrotic damage on entering. Material: ruby dust worth 1,000 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Globe of Invulnerability
spells.text: Spells of 5th level or lower cast from outside can't affect anything inside a 10-foot barrier.
spells.higher: One more spell level is blocked per slot level above 6.

spells.name: Gravity Fissure
spells.text: A 100-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line of gravity: Constitution save, 8d8 force damage (half on success); creatures within 10 feet of the line are pulled toward it.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 6.

spells.name: Guards and Wards
spells.text: Ward up to 2,500 square feet with fog, locked doors, webs, misleading passages and extra effects.

spells.name: Harm
spells.text: A creature makes a Constitution save, taking 14d6 necrotic damage (half on success) and its hit point maximum drops by that much; it can't drop below 1 HP.

spells.name: Heal
spells.text: A creature regains 70 hit points and is cured of blindness, deafness and diseases.
spells.higher: Healing increases by 10 per slot level above 6.

spells.name: Heroes' Feast
spells.text: Up to twelve creatures feast: cured of disease and poison, immune to poison and fear, advantage on Wisdom saves and +2d10 max HP for 24 hours. Material: a bowl worth 1,000 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Investiture of Flame
spells.text: You burn: immune to fire, resistant to cold, creatures near you take 1d10 fire, and as an action you shoot a 15-foot line of fire (4d8, Dexterity save).

spells.name: Investiture of Ice
spells.text: Immune to cold, resistant to fire, you move across ice freely, the ground near you is difficult terrain, and as an action a 15-foot cone of cold (4d6, Constitution save, speed halved).

spells.name: Investiture of Stone
spells.text: Resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing, an action to make creatures within 15 feet fall prone (Dexterity save), and you move through earth and stone.

spells.name: Investiture of Wind
spells.text: Ranged weapon attacks against you have disadvantage, you gain a flying speed of 60 feet, and as an action a 15-foot cube of wind (2d10 bludgeoning, Constitution save, pushed).

spells.name: Magic Jar
spells.text: Your soul moves into a container, from which you can possess a humanoid within 100 feet (Charisma save). Material: a gem or reliquary worth 500 gp.

spells.name: Mass Suggestion
spells.text: Up to twelve creatures make a Wisdom save or follow a reasonable suggestion.
spells.higher: Level 7: 10 days. Level 8: 30 days. Level 9: a year and a day.

spells.name: Mental Prison
spells.text: A creature makes an Intelligence save, taking 5d10 psychic damage (half on success); on a failure it is restrained by an illusion and takes 10d10 if it tries to leave.

spells.name: Move Earth
spells.text: Reshape dirt, sand or clay in a 40-foot square every 10 minutes.

spells.name: Otiluke's Freezing Sphere
spells.text: A frigid globe explodes in a 60-foot-radius sphere: Constitution save, 10d6 cold damage (half on success); it freezes water. It can be held to throw later.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 6.

spells.name: Otto's Irresistible Dance
spells.text: A creature dances uncontrollably: it uses its movement dancing, has disadvantage on Dexterity saves and attacks, and attacks against it have advantage. It saves with an action.

spells.name: Planar Ally
spells.text: Your deity sends a celestial, elemental or fiend to help with a task in exchange for payment.

spells.name: Primordial Ward
spells.text: You have resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning and thunder; you can end the spell as a reaction to gain immunity to one of them for a turn.

spells.name: Programmed Illusion
spells.text: An illusion up to a 30-foot cube that performs a scripted 5-minute act when triggered. Material: jade dust worth 25 gp.

spells.name: Scatter
spells.text: Up to five creatures teleport to spaces you choose within 120 feet (Wisdom save if unwilling).

spells.name: Soul Cage
spells.text: When a humanoid dies, trap its soul in a cage to heal yourself, ask questions, borrow its experience or see its last memories. Material: a silver cage worth 100 gp.

spells.name: Summon Fiend
spells.text: Summon a Fiendish Spirit (demon, devil or yugoloth) that obeys you. Its stats scale with the spell's level. Material: humanoid blood in a ruby vial worth 600 gp.
spells.higher: Uses the higher slot level in its stat block.

spells.name: Sunbeam
spells.text: A 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line of sunlight: Constitution save, 6d8 radiant damage and blinded (half on success). Repeat as an action each turn.

spells.name: Tasha's Otherworldly Guise
spells.text: Take on a celestial or fiendish form: immunities, a flying speed of 40 feet, +2 AC, magical weapon attacks using your spellcasting ability, and two attacks per Attack action. Material: an object with a celestial or fiendish symbol worth 500 gp.

spells.name: Tenser's Transformation
spells.text: You gain 50 temporary HP, advantage on weapon attacks, +2d12 force damage on weapon hits, proficiency with armor, weapons and Strength and Constitution saves, and two attacks. You can't cast spells; Constitution save or exhaustion when it ends.

spells.name: Transport via Plants
spells.text: Link a large plant to another on the same plane; creatures can step through from one to the other.

spells.name: True Seeing
spells.text: A creature gains truesight out to 120 feet. Material: an ointment worth 25 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Wall of Ice
spells.text: A wall of ice (ten 10-foot panels or a dome): Dexterity save, 10d6 cold damage (half on success). Breaking a section leaves frigid air (5d6 cold).
spells.higher: Damage increases by 2d6 per slot level above 6.

spells.name: Wall of Thorns
spells.text: A wall of thorny brush 60 feet long that blocks sight: Dexterity save, 7d8 piercing damage (half on success); moving through costs 4 feet per foot and deals 7d8 slashing.
spells.higher: Both damages increase by 1d8 per slot level above 6.

spells.name: Wind Walk
spells.text: You and up to ten creatures become clouds: flying speed 300 feet, resistance to nonmagical damage.

spells.name: Word of Recall
spells.text: You and up to five willing creatures teleport to a sanctuary you designated.

spells.name: Conjure Celestial
spells.text: Summon a celestial of CR 4 or lower that obeys you.
spells.higher: Level 9: CR 5.

spells.name: Create Magen
spells.text: Create a magen (demos, galvan or hypnos) bound to you; your hit point maximum drops while it exists. Material: a vial of quicksilver and a doll worth 1,500 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Crown of Stars
spells.text: Seven motes orbit your head. As a bonus action fire one (ranged spell attack, 4d12 radiant). They shed light.
spells.higher: Two more motes per slot level above 7.

spells.name: Delayed Blast Fireball
spells.text: A bead of fire explodes when the spell ends: 20-foot-radius sphere, Dexterity save, 12d6 fire damage plus 1d6 per turn it waited (half on success).
spells.higher: Base damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 7.

spells.name: Divine Word
spells.text: Creatures you choose make a Charisma save; those that fail are deafened, blinded, stunned or killed depending on their current HP. Celestials, elementals, fey and fiends are banished.

spells.name: Draconic Transformation
spells.text: You gain blindsight 30 feet, a 60-foot cone breath weapon (6d8 force, Dexterity save) usable as a bonus action, and spectral wings with a flying speed of 60 feet.

spells.name: Dream of the Blue Veil
spells.text: You and up to eight willing creatures dream your way to another world of the Material Plane you know about.

spells.name: Etherealness
spells.text: Step into the Border Ethereal, moving through objects and seeing the Material Plane in gray.
spells.higher: Three more willing creatures per slot level above 7.

spells.name: Finger of Death
spells.text: A creature makes a Constitution save, taking 7d8 + 30 necrotic damage (half on success); a humanoid killed rises as a zombie under your control.

spells.name: Fire Storm
spells.text: Up to ten 10-foot cubes of fire: Dexterity save, 7d10 fire damage (half on success).

spells.name: Forcecage
spells.text: An invisible prison of force (cage or box) traps creatures in a 20-foot or 10-foot cube. Material: ruby dust worth 1,500 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Mirage Arcane
spells.text: Terrain up to 1 square mile looks, sounds and feels like another kind.

spells.name: Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion
spells.text: An extradimensional mansion with food and servants for up to 100 people. Material: a portal miniature and items worth 15 gp.

spells.name: Mordenkainen's Sword
spells.text: A spectral sword: melee spell attack for 3d10 force damage; move it 20 feet and attack again as a bonus action. Material: a miniature sword worth 250 gp.

spells.name: Plane Shift
spells.text: You and up to eight creatures travel to another plane, or banish a creature with a melee spell attack and failed Charisma save. Material: a forked metal rod worth 250 gp.

spells.name: Power Word: Pain
spells.text: A creature with 100 HP or fewer is wracked with pain: speed at most 10 feet, disadvantage on attacks, checks and saves except Constitution, and a Constitution save to cast spells. It repeats the save each turn.

spells.name: Prismatic Spray
spells.text: Each creature in a 60-foot cone makes a Dexterity save and is hit by a random color: fire, acid, lightning, poison, cold (10d6 each), restraining (petrifies), blinding (may banish), or two colors.

spells.name: Project Image
spells.text: An illusory copy of you appears at a place you have seen; you see, hear and cast through it. Material: a statuette of you worth 5 gp.

spells.name: Regenerate
spells.text: A creature regains 4d8 + 15 hit points, then 1 HP each round, and severed limbs regrow after 2 minutes.

spells.name: Resurrection
spells.text: A creature dead up to a century returns with all its hit points. Material: a diamond worth 1,000 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Reverse Gravity
spells.text: Gravity reverses in a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder.

spells.name: Sequester
spells.text: A creature or object is hidden from divination and becomes invisible; creatures enter suspended animation. Material: gem dust worth 5,000 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Simulacrum
spells.text: Create an obedient duplicate of a beast or humanoid with half its hit points. Material: ruby dust worth 1,500 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Symbol
spells.text: A glyph that triggers on a condition: death (10d10 necrotic), discord, fear, hopelessness, insanity, pain, sleep or stunning, in a 60-foot sphere. Material: mercury, phosphorus and gem dust worth 1,000 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Teleport
spells.text: You and up to eight creatures (or one object) teleport anywhere on the same plane; accuracy depends on familiarity.

spells.name: Temple of the Gods
spells.text: Create a temple: creatures of chosen types must save to enter, divination is blocked, and healing inside gains a bonus equal to your Wisdom modifier. Material: a holy symbol worth 5 gp.

spells.name: Tether Essence
spells.text: Two creatures are linked: damage or healing to one is mirrored on the other, and if one drops to 0 HP so does the other. Material: a spool of platinum cord worth 250 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Whirlwind
spells.text: A 10-foot-radius, 30-foot-high whirlwind: Dexterity save, 10d6 bludgeoning (half on success); a Large or smaller creature that fails is restrained and pulled inside.

spells.name: Abi-Dalzim's Horrid Wilting
spells.text: Each creature in a 30-foot cube makes a Constitution save, taking 12d8 necrotic damage (half on success); plants and water elementals have disadvantage.

spells.name: Animal Shapes
spells.text: Willing creatures turn into beasts of CR 4 or lower.

spells.name: Antimagic Field
spells.text: A 10-foot sphere where magic doesn't work.

spells.name: Antipathy/Sympathy
spells.text: An object or area repels or attracts a kind of creature you name.

spells.name: Clone
spells.text: Grow an inert duplicate of a creature; its soul transfers there if it dies. Material: a diamond worth 1,000 gp (consumed) and a vessel worth 2,000 gp.

spells.name: Control Weather
spells.text: Change precipitation, temperature and wind within 5 miles.

spells.name: Dark Star
spells.text: A 40-foot-radius sphere of magical darkness and crushing gravity: difficult terrain, silenced, and a Constitution save each turn for 8d10 force damage (half on success).

spells.name: Demiplane
spells.text: A shadowy door opens to a 30-foot-cube empty room.

spells.name: Dominate Monster
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save or is charmed and follows your commands; it repeats the save when damaged.
spells.higher: Level 9: 8 hours.

spells.name: Earthquake
spells.text: A 100-foot-radius tremor: difficult terrain, creatures fall prone, concentration breaks, fissures open and structures collapse.

spells.name: Feeblemind
spells.text: A creature takes 4d6 psychic damage and makes an Intelligence save or its Intelligence and Charisma become 1, repeating the save every 30 days.

spells.name: Glibness
spells.text: Treat any Charisma check roll of 14 or lower as 15, and magic that detects lies shows you as truthful.

spells.name: Holy Aura
spells.text: Creatures you choose within 30 feet have advantage on saves and attacks against them have disadvantage; fiends and undead that hit them may be blinded. Material: a reliquary worth 1,000 gp.

spells.name: Illusory Dragon
spells.text: A Huge illusory dragon frightens creatures (Wisdom save) and as a bonus action moves and breathes a 60-foot cone (Intelligence save, 7d6 of a type you choose).

spells.name: Incendiary Cloud
spells.text: A 20-foot-radius sphere of burning smoke that moves 10 feet each turn: Dexterity save, 10d8 fire damage (half on success).

spells.name: Maddening Darkness
spells.text: A 60-foot-radius sphere of magical darkness; creatures starting their turn there make a Wisdom save or take 8d8 psychic damage (half on success).

spells.name: Maze
spells.text: Banish a creature into a labyrinthine demiplane; it escapes with a DC 20 Intelligence check.

spells.name: Mighty Fortress
spells.text: A stone fortress with walls, towers and a keep rises; it vanishes after 7 days unless cast there again each week. Material: a diamond worth 500 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Mind Blank
spells.text: A creature is immune to psychic damage, charm, mind reading and divination.

spells.name: Power Word: Stun
spells.text: A creature with 150 HP or fewer is stunned, repeating a Constitution save each turn.

spells.name: Reality Break
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save each turn or suffers a random effect (d10): stunned, 6d12 psychic, 8d12 force, or teleport and 10d12 cold.

spells.name: Sunburst
spells.text: A 60-foot-radius sphere of sunlight: Constitution save, 12d6 radiant damage and blinded for 1 minute (half on success).

spells.name: Telepathy
spells.text: A telepathic link with a familiar willing creature on the same plane.

spells.name: Tsunami
spells.text: A wall of water 300 feet long and tall: Strength save, 6d10 bludgeoning (half on success), moving and shrinking each round.

spells.name: Astral Projection
spells.text: You and up to eight creatures project astral bodies into the Astral Plane. Material: a jacinth worth 1,000 gp and a silver bar worth 100 gp per creature, consumed.

spells.name: Blade of Disaster
spells.text: A blade-shaped rift makes two melee spell attacks for 4d12 force damage each (critical on 18-20); move it 30 feet and attack again as a bonus action.

spells.name: Foresight
spells.text: A creature can't be surprised, has advantage on attacks, checks and saves, and attacks against it have disadvantage.

spells.name: Gate
spells.text: Open a portal to another plane; naming a creature pulls it through. Material: a diamond worth 5,000 gp.

spells.name: Imprisonment
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save or is imprisoned: burial, chaining, hedged prison, minimus containment or slumber. Material: a statuette worth 500 gp per Hit Die.

spells.name: Invulnerability
spells.text: You are immune to all damage. Material: adamantine worth 500 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Mass Heal
spells.text: Restore up to 700 hit points divided among creatures, curing disease, blindness and deafness.

spells.name: Mass Polymorph
spells.text: Up to ten creatures make a Wisdom save or turn into beasts of CR up to their CR or level.

spells.name: Meteor Swarm
spells.text: Four meteors explode in 40-foot-radius spheres: Dexterity save, 20d6 fire and 20d6 bludgeoning damage (half on success).

spells.name: Power Word: Heal
spells.text: A creature regains all its hit points and is freed from being charmed, frightened, paralyzed and stunned.

spells.name: Power Word: Kill
spells.text: A creature with 100 hit points or fewer dies.

spells.name: Prismatic Wall
spells.text: A seven-layered wall of light; each layer has its own effect and means of destruction.

spells.name: Psychic Scream
spells.text: Up to ten creatures with Intelligence 3+ make an Intelligence save, taking 14d6 psychic damage and stunned (half on success). A creature killed has its head explode.

spells.name: Ravenous Void
spells.text: A 20-foot-radius sphere of destructive gravity pulls creatures within 100 feet toward it; those starting their turn inside are restrained and take 5d10 force damage.

spells.name: Shapechange
spells.text: Turn into a creature of CR up to your level and change form as an action. Material: a jade circlet worth 1,500 gp.

spells.name: Storm of Vengeance
spells.text: A 360-foot-radius storm cloud: thunder, acid rain, lightning, hail and freezing wind over several rounds.

spells.name: Time Ravage
spells.text: A creature makes a Constitution save, taking 10d12 necrotic damage (half on success); on a failure it ages to near death. Material: an hourglass with diamond dust worth 5,000 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Time Stop
spells.text: Time stops for everyone else; you take 1d4 + 1 turns in a row.

spells.name: True Polymorph
spells.text: Turn a creature or object into another creature or object; permanent if held for the full hour.

spells.name: True Resurrection
spells.text: A creature dead up to 200 years returns fully restored, even without a body. Material: diamonds worth 25,000 gp, consumed.

spells.name: Weird
spells.text: Creatures in a 30-foot-radius sphere make a Wisdom save or are frightened, taking 4d10 psychic damage each turn they fail.

spells.name: Wish
spells.text: Duplicate any spell of 8th level or lower, or create another effect at great risk.
